steps.name: Create Google Play access token
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test -n "${PLAY_CONSOLE_KEY_JSON:-}"

credentials="$RUNNER_TEMP/play-console-key.json"
private_key="$RUNNER_TEMP/play-console-private-key.pem"
printf '%s' "$PLAY_CONSOLE_KEY_JSON" > "$credentials"
jq -er '.private_key' "$credentials" > "$private_key"
chmod 600 "$credentials" "$private_key"

client_email=$(jq -er '.client_email' "$credentials")
token_uri=$(jq -er '.token_uri' "$credentials")
now=$(date +%s)

base64url() {
  openssl base64 -A | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='
}

header=$(printf '%s' '{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}' | base64url)
claims=$(jq -nc \
  --arg iss "$client_email" \
  --arg scope 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/androidpublisher' \
  --arg aud "$token_uri" \
  --argjson iat "$now" \
  '{iss: $iss, scope: $scope, aud: $aud, iat: $iat, exp: ($iat + 3600)}' \
  | base64url)
unsigned="$header.$claims"
signature=$(printf '%s' "$unsigned" \
  | openssl dgst -sha256 -sign "$private_key" \
  | base64url)

token_response=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST "$token_uri" \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer' \
  --data-urlencode "assertion=$unsigned.$signature")
access_token=$(printf '%s' "$token_response" | jq -er '.access_token')
echo "::add-mask::$access_token"
echo "access_token=$access_token" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

rm -f "$credentials" "$private_key"

steps.name: Resolve published production release
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
releases_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-releases.json"
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  "https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/${PACKAGE_NAME}/tracks/production/releases" \
  -o "$releases_file"

requested_code="${INPUT_VERSION_CODE:-${DISPATCH_VERSION_CODE:-}}"
if [[ -n "$requested_code" && (! "$requested_code" =~ ^[0-9]+$ || "$requested_code" == 0) ]]; then
  echo "::error::versionCode must be a positive integer"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ -n "$requested_code" \
  && "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" != "workflow_dispatch" \
  && "$requested_code" -le "$BASELINE_VERSION_CODE" ]]; then
  echo "found=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "Ignoring automated request for baseline versionCode $requested_code."
  exit 0
fi

if [[ -n "$requested_code" ]]; then
  candidate=$(jq -c --argjson requested "$requested_code" '
    [
      .releases[]?
      | select(.releaseLifecycleState == "RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_PUBLISHED") as $release
      | $release.activeArtifacts[]?
      | select((.versionCode | tonumber) == $requested)
      | {
          version_code: (.versionCode | tonumber),
          release_name: $release.releaseName,
          lifecycle_state: $release.releaseLifecycleState
        }
    ]
    | max_by(.version_code) // empty
  ' "$releases_file")
else
  candidate=$(jq -c --argjson baseline "$BASELINE_VERSION_CODE" '
    [
      .releases[]?
      | select(.releaseLifecycleState == "RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_PUBLISHED") as $release
      | $release.activeArtifacts[]?
      | select((.versionCode | tonumber) > $baseline)
      | {
          version_code: (.versionCode | tonumber),
          release_name: $release.releaseName,
          lifecycle_state: $release.releaseLifecycleState
        }
    ]
    | max_by(.version_code) // empty
  ' "$releases_file")
fi

if [[ -z "$candidate" ]]; then
  echo "found=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No matching published production release is available."
  exit 0
fi

version_code=$(printf '%s' "$candidate" | jq -er '.version_code')

mapfile -t matching_tags < <(
  while IFS= read -r tag; do
    gradle=$(git show "$tag:apps/android/app/build.gradle.kts" 2>/dev/null || true)
    tag_code=$(printf '%s\n' "$gradle" \
      | sed -n 's/.*versionCode = \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' \
      | head -1)
    if [[ "$tag_code" == "$version_code" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$tag"
    fi
  done < <(git tag --list 'android/v*')
)

if [[ ${#matching_tags[@]} -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "::error::Expected exactly one android/v* tag for production versionCode $version_code; found ${#matching_tags[@]}"
  exit 1
fi

tag=${matching_tags[0]}
if [[ "$(git cat-file -t "$tag")" != "tag" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$tag must be an annotated release tag"
  exit 1
fi

gradle=$(git show "$tag:apps/android/app/build.gradle.kts")
version=$(printf '%s\n' "$gradle" \
  | sed -n 's/.*versionName = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' \
  | head -1)
if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Committed Android versionName is not a release semantic version"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$tag" != "android/v$version" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Tag $tag does not match its committed Android versionName ($version)"
  exit 1
fi

sha=$(git rev-parse "$tag^{}")
git rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/main >/dev/null
if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$sha" refs/remotes/origin/main; then
  echo "::error::$tag does not point to a commit reachable from origin/main"
  exit 1
fi

notes_file="$RUNNER_TEMP/android-release-notes.md"
git show "$tag:apps/android/play-console/listing/en-US/release-notes/en-US/default.txt" \
  > "$notes_file"
test -s "$notes_file"

gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$sha/statuses?per_page=100" \
  > "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-status-pages.json"
if jq -e --arg context "$STATUS_CONTEXT" '
  any(.[][]; .context == $context and .state == "success")
' "$RUNNER_TEMP/commit-status-pages.json" >/dev/null; then
  already_announced=true
else
  already_announced=false
fi

{
  echo "found=true"
  echo "already_announced=$already_announced"
  echo "version=$version"
  echo "version_code=$version_code"
  echo "tag=$tag"
  echo "sha=$sha"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Render Discord update
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
notes=$(jq -Rrs '.[0:1500]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/android-release-notes.md")
cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/discord.md" <<DISCORD_EOF
🟢 ${APP_NAME} v${VERSION} is live on Android.

${notes}

Google Play: ${GOOGLE_PLAY_URL}
DISCORD_EOF

steps.name: Preview Discord update
steps.run:
cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/discord.md"
echo "Dry run: Discord was not changed."

steps.name: Post Discord update
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test -n "${DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN:-}"

bot_response=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  "https://discord.com/api/v10/users/@me" \
  -H "Authorization: Bot $DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN" \
  -H "User-Agent: DiscordBot (https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}, 1.0)")
bot_id=$(printf '%s' "$bot_response" | jq -er '.id')

message_id=""
before=""
for _page in {1..10}; do
  messages_url="https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/${DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID}/messages?limit=100"
  if [[ -n "$before" ]]; then
    messages_url="${messages_url}&before=${before}"
  fi
  messages=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
    "$messages_url" \
    -H "Authorization: Bot $DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN" \
    -H "User-Agent: DiscordBot (https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}, 1.0)")
  message_id=$(printf '%s' "$messages" | jq -r \
    --arg bot_id "$bot_id" \
    --rawfile expected "$RUNNER_TEMP/discord.md" '
      [
        .[]
        | select(
            .author.id == $bot_id
            and .content == ($expected | rtrimstr("\n"))
          )
      ][0].id // empty
    ')
  if [[ -n "$message_id" ]]; then
    break
  fi
  message_count=$(printf '%s' "$messages" | jq 'length')
  if [[ "$message_count" -lt 100 ]]; then
    break
  fi
  before=$(printf '%s' "$messages" | jq -er '.[-1].id')
done

if [[ -n "$message_id" ]]; then
  echo "Found the existing Discord announcement; no duplicate was posted."
  posted=false
else
  payload=$(jq -n \
    --rawfile content "$RUNNER_TEMP/discord.md" \
    '{content: ($content | rtrimstr("\n")), allowed_mentions: {parse: []}}')
  # Do not retry this non-idempotent POST. If the response is lost after
  # Discord accepts it, the next run reconciles against channel history.
  response=$(curl --fail-with-body --max-time 30 -sS \
    -X POST "https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/${DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID}/messages" \
    -H "Authorization: Bot $DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H "User-Agent: DiscordBot (https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}, 1.0)" \
    --data-binary "$payload")
  message_id=$(printf '%s' "$response" | jq -er '.id')
  posted=true
fi

if [[ ! "$message_id" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Discord returned an invalid message id"
  exit 1
fi
message_url="https://discord.com/channels/${DISCORD_GUILD_ID}/${DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID}/${message_id}"
{
  echo "message_id=$message_id"
  echo "message_url=$message_url"
  echo "posted=$posted"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Discord update: $message_url"

steps.name: Record durable announcement marker
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  if gh api \
    --method POST \
    "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/statuses/$RELEASE_SHA" \
    -f state=success \
    -f context="$STATUS_CONTEXT" \
    -f description="Discord announced Android v$VERSION ($VERSION_CODE)" \
    -f target_url="$MESSAGE_URL" \
    >/dev/null; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep $((attempt * 2))
done
echo "::error::Discord succeeded, but the durable commit status could not be recorded"
exit 1

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Android production announcement"
  echo
  if [[ "$FOUND" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "- Google Play: no matching published production release"
  elif [[ "$ALREADY_ANNOUNCED" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "- Version: $VERSION ($VERSION_CODE)"
    echo "- Discord: already announced"
  elif [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "workflow_dispatch" && "$DRY_RUN" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "- Version: $VERSION ($VERSION_CODE)"
    echo "- Discord: dry-run preview only"
  else
    echo "- Version: $VERSION ($VERSION_CODE)"
    echo "- Google Play state: published"
    if [[ "$DISCORD_POSTED" == "true" ]]; then
      echo "- Discord: posted"
    elif [[ -n "$MESSAGE_URL" ]]; then
      echo "- Discord: existing bot message reused"
    else
      echo "- Discord: no message result"
    fi
    echo "- Message: $MESSAGE_URL"
    echo "- Commit status: $STATUS_CONTEXT"
  fi
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Validate audit and release identities
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = tag
[[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == android/v* || "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == android/recovery/* ]]
[[ "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^android/v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
for tag in "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" "$RELEASE_TAG"; do
  git fetch --force --no-tags origin "+refs/tags/${tag}:refs/tags/${tag}"
  test "$(git cat-file -t "$tag")" = tag
done
workflow_sha=$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_REF_NAME^{commit}")
release_sha=$(git rev-parse "$RELEASE_TAG^{commit}")
version_code=$(git show "$RELEASE_TAG:apps/android/release-scope.json" \
  | jq -er '.googlePlay.phone.versionCode | select(type == "number" and . >= 1 and . < 1000000)')
test "$workflow_sha" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
git fetch --force origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$workflow_sha" refs/remotes/origin/main
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_sha" refs/remotes/origin/main
{
  echo "workflow_sha=$workflow_sha"
  echo "release_sha=$release_sha"
  echo "version_code=$version_code"

steps.name: Retain immutable access-audit intent
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -n --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg workflow '.github/workflows/android-google-play-access-audit.yml' \
  --arg workflowRef "$GITHUB_REF" --arg workflowSha "$WORKFLOW_SHA" \
  --arg releaseTag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg releaseSha "$RELEASE_SHA" \
  --argjson versionCode "$VERSION_CODE" \

    workflowRef:$workflowRef,workflowSha:$workflowSha,releaseTag:$releaseTag,
    releaseSha:$releaseSha,versionCode:$versionCode,runId:$runId,runAttempt:$runAttempt,
    requestedChecks:["internal-track-state","generated-apks-state","empty-edit-insert-delete"],
    noPlayEditCommit:true,preparedAtUtc:$preparedAt
  }' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-access-audit-intent.json"

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Play with protected Workload Identity
Verify artifact state and empty-edit authority without committing
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
api='https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/com.healthmd.android'
work="$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-access-audit"
mkdir -p "$work"
edit_id=''
cleanup_edit() {
  [[ -z "$edit_id" ]] || curl -fsS --retry 2 --max-time 30 -X DELETE \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$api/edits/$edit_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
trap cleanup_edit EXIT
report_error() {
  local stage=$1 status=$2 body=$3 detail
  detail=$(jq -r '
    if (.error | type) == "object" then
      [(.error.status // empty), (.error.message // empty)]
      | map(select(type == "string" and length > 0)) | join(": ")
    else empty end
  ' "$body" 2>/dev/null || true)
  detail=$(printf '%s' "$detail" | tr '\r\n\t' '   ' | cut -c1-500)
  [[ -n "$detail" ]] || detail='no structured error detail'
  echo "::error::$stage failed (HTTP ${status:-000}): $detail"
}

set +e
read_http=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$api/tracks/internal/releases" \
  -o "$work/internal.json" --write-out '%{http_code}')
read_exit=$?
set -e
if [[ $read_exit -ne 0 || ! "$read_http" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
  report_error 'Internal-track read' "$read_http" "$work/internal.json"
  exit 1
fi
jq -e '.releases | type == "array"' "$work/internal.json" >/dev/null
if jq -e --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
  any(.releases[]?; any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode | tonumber) == $code))
' "$work/internal.json" >/dev/null; then
  internal_contains_code=true
else
  internal_contains_code=false
fi

# A generated-APK result can distinguish a code consumed by an earlier orphaned bundle
# upload from a code active on a track. This endpoint is read-only. Some narrowly scoped
# Play grants cannot query it; retain that as an explicit inconclusive result.
set +e
generated_http=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 2 --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  "$api/generatedApks/$VERSION_CODE" -o "$work/generated-apks.json" \
  --write-out '%{http_code}')
generated_exit=$?
set -e
generated_query_authorized=false
generated_apks_present=false
if [[ $generated_exit -eq 0 && "$generated_http" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
  jq -e '.generatedApks | type == "array"' "$work/generated-apks.json" >/dev/null
  generated_query_authorized=true
  if jq -e '(.generatedApks | length) > 0' "$work/generated-apks.json" >/dev/null; then
    generated_apks_present=true
  fi
elif [[ "$generated_http" == 404 ]]; then
  generated_query_authorized=true
else
  detail=$(jq -r '.error.message // "no structured error detail"' \
    "$work/generated-apks.json" 2>/dev/null | tr '\r\n\t' '   ' | cut -c1-500)
  echo "::warning::Generated-APK state query was inconclusive (HTTP ${generated_http:-000}): $detail"
fi

# Insert one empty edit without retries, then delete it. No bundle, track, listing, commit,
# or review endpoint is called. This proves baseline edit access, not bundle-upload authority.
set +e
edit_http=$(curl --fail-with-body --max-time 30 -sS -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{}' "$api/edits" -o "$work/edit.json" --write-out '%{http_code}')
edit_exit=$?
set -e
if [[ $edit_exit -ne 0 || ! "$edit_http" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then
  report_error 'Empty Play edit insertion' "$edit_http" "$work/edit.json"
  exit 1
fi
edit_id=$(jq -er .id "$work/edit.json")
curl --fail-with-body --retry 2 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$api/edits/$edit_id" >/dev/null
edit_id=''
trap - EXIT

jq -n --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg workflow '.github/workflows/android-google-play-access-audit.yml' \
  --arg workflowRef "$GITHUB_REF" --arg workflowSha "$WORKFLOW_SHA" \
  --arg releaseTag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg releaseSha "$RELEASE_SHA" \
  --argjson versionCode "$VERSION_CODE" \
  --argjson internalContainsCode "$internal_contains_code" \
  --argjson generatedQueryAuthorized "$generated_query_authorized" \
  --argjson generatedApksPresent "$generated_apks_present" \
  --argjson generatedHttpStatus "${generated_http:-0}" \
  --argjson runId "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --argjson runAttempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
  --arg verifiedAt "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '{
    schemaVersion:1,repository:$repository,workflow:$workflow,
    workflowRef:$workflowRef,workflowSha:$workflowSha,releaseTag:$releaseTag,
    releaseSha:$releaseSha,versionCode:$versionCode,runId:$runId,runAttempt:$runAttempt,
    workloadIdentityAuthenticated:true,internalTrackReadVerified:true,
    internalTrackContainsVersionCode:$internalContainsCode,
    generatedApksQueryAuthorized:$generatedQueryAuthorized,
    generatedApksQueryHttpStatus:$generatedHttpStatus,
    generatedApksPresent:$generatedApksPresent,
    emptyEditInsertDeleteVerified:true,noPlayEditCommit:true,
    verifiedAtUtc:$verifiedAt
  }' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-access-audit-receipt.json"

steps.name: Verify original promotion run and exact paired edit step
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
base="https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${ORIGINAL_RUN_ID}"
attempt_base="$base/attempts/$ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT"
for pair in \
  "$attempt_base $RUNNER_TEMP/original-run.json" \
  "$attempt_base/jobs?per_page=100 $RUNNER_TEMP/original-jobs.json" \

steps.name: Create Google Play access token

set -euo pipefail
key="$RUNNER_TEMP/play-console-key.json"
private="$RUNNER_TEMP/play-console-private-key.pem"
jq -er .private_key "$key" >"$private"; chmod 600 "$private"
now=$(date +%s)
base64url() { openssl base64 -A | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='; }
header=$(printf '%s' '{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}' | base64url)
claims=$(jq -nc --arg iss "$(jq -er .client_email "$key")" --arg aud "$(jq -er .token_uri "$key")" \
  --argjson iat "$now" '{iss:$iss,scope:"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/androidpublisher",aud:$aud,iat:$iat,exp:($iat+1200)}' | base64url)

  --data-urlencode "assertion=$header.$claims.$signature" \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer' \
  "$(jq -er .token_uri "$key")" | jq -er .access_token)
echo "::add-mask::$token"
echo "access_token=$token" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
rm -f "$private"

version.description: Exact Android semantic version to promote

version_code.description: Exact phone versionCode to promote from Internal Testing

release_tag.description: Existing immutable release tag; set only when dispatching a workflow-only recovery tag

steps.name: Validate immutable phone promotion request
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = tag
expected_tag="android/v$VERSION"
[[ -z "$RELEASE_TAG" || "$RELEASE_TAG" == "$expected_tag" ]]
git fetch --force --no-tags origin "+refs/tags/${expected_tag}:refs/tags/${expected_tag}"
test "$(git cat-file -t "$expected_tag")" = tag
tagged_sha="$(git rev-parse "$expected_tag^{commit}")"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$tagged_sha"
git fetch --force origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$tagged_sha" refs/remotes/origin/main
if [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == "$expected_tag" ]]; then
  test "$GITHUB_SHA" = "$tagged_sha"
  recovery=false
else
  test "$RELEASE_TAG" = "$expected_tag"
  [[ "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" == android/recovery/* ]]
  git fetch --force --no-tags origin "+refs/tags/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}:refs/tags/${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
  test "$(git cat-file -t "$GITHUB_REF_NAME")" = tag
  test "$(git rev-parse "$GITHUB_REF_NAME^{commit}")" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
  git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" refs/remotes/origin/main
  recovery=true
fi
[[ "$VERSION" =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
[[ "$VERSION_CODE" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
(( VERSION_CODE < 1000000 ))

tagged_gradle="$(git show "$expected_tag:apps/android/app/build.gradle.kts")"
tagged_version="$(printf '%s\n' "$tagged_gradle" | sed -n 's/.*versionName = "\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)"
tagged_code="$(printf '%s\n' "$tagged_gradle" | sed -n 's/.*versionCode = \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1)"
test "$tagged_version" = "$VERSION"
test "$tagged_code" = "$VERSION_CODE"
jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
  .schemaVersion == 1 and .releaseVersionName == $version and
  .googlePlay.phone.status == "release_candidate" and
  .googlePlay.phone.versionCode == $code and
  .googlePlay.phone.testingTrack == "internal" and
  .googlePlay.phone.productionTrack == "production" and
  .googlePlay.wear.status == "deferred" and .googlePlay.wear.published == false
' release-scope.json >/dev/null
{
  echo "tag=$expected_tag"
  echo "sha=$tagged_sha"
  echo "workflow_sha=$GITHUB_SHA"
  echo "workflow_ref=$GITHUB_REF"
  echo "recovery=$recovery"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Create immutable phone promotion intent
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
jq -n --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
  --arg workflow '.github/workflows/android-promote-production.yml' \
  --arg workflowSha "${{ steps.release.outputs.workflow_sha }}" \
  --arg workflowRef "${{ steps.release.outputs.workflow_ref }}" \
  --argjson recovery "${{ steps.release.outputs.recovery }}" \
  --argjson runId "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --argjson runAttempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
  --arg sha "$RELEASE_SHA" --arg version "$VERSION" --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" \
  --arg preparedAt "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" '{
    schemaVersion:1,repository:$repository,workflow:$workflow,
    workflowSha:$workflowSha,workflowRef:$workflowRef,workflowRecovery:$recovery,
    runId:$runId,runAttempt:$runAttempt,releaseSha:$sha,versionName:$version,
    phoneVersionCode:$code,sourceTrack:"internal",destinationTrack:"production",
    wearIncluded:false,promotionPrepared:true,preparedAtUtc:$preparedAt
  }' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/phone-production-intent.json"

steps.name: Authenticate to Google Play with protected Workload Identity
Verify Internal Testing source and production precondition
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
api="https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/${PACKAGE_NAME}"
for track in internal production; do
  curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
    "$api/tracks/$track/releases" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-$track-before.json"
done
internal="$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-internal-before.json"
production="$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-before.json"
has_code() {
  jq -e --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
    any(.releases[]?; any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode | tonumber) == $code))
  ' "$1" >/dev/null
}
max_production=$(jq '[.releases[]?.activeArtifacts[]?.versionCode | tonumber] | max // 0' "$production")
(( max_production <= VERSION_CODE )) || {
  echo "::error::Production contains newer versionCode $max_production"; exit 1;
}
if has_code "$production"; then
  state=$(jq -r --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
    first(.releases[]? | select(any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode|tonumber)==$code)) | .releaseLifecycleState) // empty
  ' "$production")
  case "$state" in
    RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_IN_REVIEW|RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_APPROVED_NOT_PUBLISHED|RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_PUBLISHED)
      echo 'mutation_required=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      ;;
    *)
      echo 'mutation_required=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      echo 'source_track=production' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      ;;
  esac
else
  has_code "$internal" || {
    echo "::error::versionCode $VERSION_CODE is not active on Internal Testing"; exit 1;
  }
  echo 'mutation_required=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo 'source_track=internal' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Promote exact phone artifact and submit it for review
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# shellcheck source=apps/android/scripts/google-play-phone-policy.sh
source scripts/google-play-phone-policy.sh
api="https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/${PACKAGE_NAME}"
edit_id=''
committed=false
cleanup_edit() {
  if [[ -n "$edit_id" && "$committed" != true ]]; then
    curl -fsS --retry 2 -X DELETE -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
      "$api/edits/$edit_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup_edit EXIT
edit_id=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{}' "$api/edits" | jq -er .id)

# Submit only the reviewed locale, in the same edit as production, so the listing cannot
# advertise a deferred capability and cannot drift from the binary under review.
locale=en-US
listing_dir="play-console/listing/$locale"
for file in title.txt short-description.txt full-description.txt; do
  test -s "$listing_dir/$file"
done
listing_payload=$(jq -nc --arg language "$locale" \
  --rawfile title "$listing_dir/title.txt" \
  --rawfile short "$listing_dir/short-description.txt" \
  --rawfile full "$listing_dir/full-description.txt" '{
    language:$language,
    title:($title | sub("\\n+$"; "")),
    shortDescription:($short | sub("\\n+$"; "")),
    fullDescription:($full | sub("\\n+$"; ""))
  }')
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data "$listing_payload" "$api/edits/$edit_id/listings/$locale" \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-listing-update.json"
jq -e --argjson expected "$listing_payload" '
  .language == $expected.language and .title == $expected.title and
  .shortDescription == $expected.shortDescription and
  .fullDescription == $expected.fullDescription
' "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-listing-update.json" >/dev/null

source_encoded=${SOURCE_TRACK//:/%3A}
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  "$api/edits/$edit_id/tracks/$source_encoded" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-source-edit.json"
play_phone_promotion_payload "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-source-edit.json" production \
  "$VERSION_CODE" "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-payload.json"
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X PUT -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary "@$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-payload.json" \
  "$api/edits/$edit_id/tracks/production" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-update.json"
play_phone_validate_track_response "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-update.json" \
  "$VERSION_CODE" completed
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '' "$api/edits/$edit_id:validate" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-validation.json"

# This POST is non-idempotent: issue it exactly once, then reconcile a lost response.
commit_response_received=true
set +e
curl --fail-with-body --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  "$api/edits/$edit_id:commit?changesNotSentForReview=false&changesInReviewBehavior=ERROR_IF_IN_REVIEW" \
  --data '' -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-commit.json"
commit_exit_code=$?
set -e
if [[ $commit_exit_code -eq 22 ]]; then
  jq -r '.error.message // .errorMessage // "(no body)"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-commit.json" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
  echo '::error::Production commit received a definite HTTP rejection; reconciliation is forbidden'
  exit 1
elif [[ $commit_exit_code -ne 0 ]]; then
  commit_response_received=false
fi

commit_visible=false
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  if curl --fail-with-body --retry 2 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$api/tracks/production/releases" \
      -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-after.json" \
    && jq -e --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
      any(.releases[]?; any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode|tonumber)==$code))
    ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-after.json" >/dev/null; then
    commit_visible=true
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done
$commit_visible || { echo '::error::Production commit postcondition is absent'; exit 1; }
committed=true
{
  echo "edit_id=$edit_id"
  echo "commit_response_received=$commit_response_received"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Verify Google Play review lifecycle
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
api="https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/${PACKAGE_NAME}"
for _ in $(seq 1 40); do
  curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" "$api/tracks/production/releases" \
    -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-review.json"
  candidate=$(jq -c --argjson code "$VERSION_CODE" '
    first(.releases[]? | select(any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode|tonumber)==$code))) // empty
  ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/google-play-production-review.json")
  state=$(jq -r '.releaseLifecycleState // empty' <<< "$candidate")
  case "$state" in
    RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_IN_REVIEW|RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_APPROVED_NOT_PUBLISHED|RELEASE_LIFECYCLE_STATE_PUBLISHED)
      echo "lifecycle_state=$state" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      echo "release_name=$(jq -r '.releaseName // ""' <<< "$candidate")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      exit 0
      ;;
  esac
  sleep 15
done
echo "::error::Production versionCode $VERSION_CODE was not proven submitted for review"
exit 1

printf '%s' "$PLAY_CONSOLE_KEY_JSON" >"$key"; chmod 600 "$key"
jq -er .private_key "$key" >"$private"; chmod 600 "$private"
now=$(date +%s)
base64url() { openssl base64 -A | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '='; }
header=$(printf '%s' '{"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT"}' | base64url)
claims=$(jq -nc --arg iss "$(jq -er .client_email "$key")" --arg aud "$(jq -er .token_uri "$key")" \
  --argjson iat "$now" '{iss:$iss,scope:"https://www.googleapis.com/auth/androidpublisher",aud:$aud,iat:$iat,exp:($iat+1200)}' | base64url)
signature=$(printf '%s' "$header.$claims" | openssl dgst -sha256 -sign "$private" | base64url)
token=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  --data-urlencode "assertion=$header.$claims.$signature" \
  --data-urlencode 'grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer' \
  "$(jq -er .token_uri "$key")" | jq -er .access_token)
echo "::add-mask::$token"
root="$RUNNER_TEMP/wear-release-evidence/qa-upload"
api="https://androidpublisher.googleapis.com/androidpublisher/v3/applications/${PACKAGE_NAME}/tracks"
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" "$api/qa/releases" -o "$root/google-play-qa-current.json"
curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" "$api/wear:internal/releases" -o "$root/google-play-wear-qa-current.json"
jq -e --argjson code "$PHONE_VERSION_CODE" '
  any(.releases[]?; any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode | tonumber) == $code))
' "$root/google-play-qa-current.json" >/dev/null

  any(.releases[]?; any(.activeArtifacts[]?; (.versionCode | tonumber) == $code))
' "$root/google-play-wear-qa-current.json" >/dev/null
cleanup_play; trap - EXIT

[[ "$PLAY_SIGNER" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ && -n "$SCREENSHOT_REVIEWER" && -n "$SCREENSHOT_TICKET" ]]

python3 ./scripts/verify-wear-play-screenshot-evidence.py \

  --expected-reviewer "$SCREENSHOT_REVIEWER" --expected-review-ticket "$SCREENSHOT_TICKET" >/dev/null
mkdir -p play-store/wear/screenshots
cp "$root/wear-screenshots/wear-app.png" play-store/wear/screenshots/wear-app.png
cp "$root/wear-screenshots/wear-tile.png" play-store/wear/screenshots/wear-tile.png
echo "WEAR_APK_SHA256=$wear_apk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

dry_run.description: Preview release metadata and notes without publishing side effects

force_promotion.description: Promote the draft without requiring both platforms approved (escape hatch)

steps.name: Install asc
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v asc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  brew install asc
fi
asc --version

steps.name: Setup App Store Connect key
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
ASC_KEY_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/.asc-keys"
mkdir -p "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
chmod 700 "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
ASC_KEY_PATH="$ASC_KEY_DIR/AuthKey_${ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET}.p8"
echo "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" | base64 --decode > "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
chmod 600 "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
{
  echo "ASC_KEY_ID=$ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_ISSUER_ID=$ASC_ISSUER_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=$ASC_KEY_PATH"
  echo "ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Check both platforms approved
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "$FORCE" == "true" ]]; then
  echo "::warning::force_promotion=true — skipping both-platform approval check"
  echo "promote=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi
[[ "$PLATFORM" == "MACOS" ]] && PLATFORM=MAC_OS
case "$PLATFORM" in
  IOS) OTHER=MAC_OS ;;
  MAC_OS) OTHER=IOS ;;
  *) echo "::error::Unsupported platform: $PLATFORM"; exit 1 ;;
esac
OTHER_STATE=$(asc versions list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --platform "$OTHER" --limit 20 --output json \
  | jq -r --arg version "$VERSION" \
    '[.data[] | select(.attributes.versionString == $version)][0].attributes.appStoreState // "NOT_FOUND"')
echo "other_platform=$OTHER state=$OTHER_STATE"
case "$OTHER_STATE" in
  READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION|READY_FOR_SALE)
    echo "promote=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    ;;
  NOT_FOUND)
    echo "::notice::$OTHER has no $VERSION version; treating release as single-platform"
    echo "promote=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    ;;
  *)
    echo "::notice::$OTHER $VERSION is $OTHER_STATE — deferring draft promotion until both platforms are approved"
    echo "promote=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
    ;;
esac

steps.name: Verify CLI dependencies
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
gh --version
jq --version

steps.name: Resolve dispatch payload
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

if [[ "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" == "repository_dispatch" ]]; then
  case "$STATE" in
    READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION|READY_FOR_SALE) ;;
    *) echo "::error::Unexpected approval state: ${STATE:-missing}"; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  if [[ "$PAYLOAD_APP_STORE_ID" != "$ASC_APP_ID" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Dispatch App Store ID '${PAYLOAD_APP_STORE_ID:-missing}' does not match '$ASC_APP_ID'"
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ -z "$ASCV_ID" || -z "$PAYLOAD_VERSION" || -z "$PAYLOAD_PLATFORM" || -z "$PAYLOAD_DELIVERY_KEY" || -z "$PAYLOAD_EVENT_TIMESTAMP" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Approval dispatch is missing appStoreVersionId, version, platform, deliveryKey, or eventTimestamp"
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="$PAYLOAD_VERSION"
  PLATFORM="$PAYLOAD_PLATFORM"
  echo "Webhook mode: appStoreVersionId=$ASCV_ID version=$VERSION platform=$PLATFORM state=$STATE"
else
  VERSION="$INPUT_VERSION"
  PLATFORM="$INPUT_PLATFORM"
  echo "Manual mode: version=$VERSION platform=$PLATFORM"
fi

[[ "$PLATFORM" == "MACOS" ]] && PLATFORM=MAC_OS
if [[ ! "$VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,2}$ || -z "$PLATFORM" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not resolve a valid version + platform"
  exit 1
fi
case "$PLATFORM" in
  IOS|MAC_OS) ;;
  *) echo "::error::Unsupported platform: $PLATFORM (only IOS / MAC_OS supported)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

PLATFORM_LABEL=$([[ "$PLATFORM" == "MAC_OS" ]] && echo macOS || echo iOS)
DELIVERY_KEY="${PAYLOAD_DELIVERY_KEY:-manual:${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:${VERSION}:${PLATFORM}}"
EVENT_TIMESTAMP="${PAYLOAD_EVENT_TIMESTAMP:-}"
{
  echo "version=$VERSION"
  echo "platform=$PLATFORM"
  echo "tag=v$VERSION"
  echo "platform_label=$PLATFORM_LABEL"
  echo "delivery_key=$DELIVERY_KEY"
  echo "event_timestamp=$EVENT_TIMESTAMP"
  echo "dry_run=${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.dry_run == true }}"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Fetch release (or use dispatch notes)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
NOTES_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md"
NOTES=""

if gh release view "$TAG" --json id,isDraft,body,publishedAt > "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json" 2>/dev/null; then
  NOTES=$(jq -r '.body // empty' "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json")
  IS_DRAFT=$(jq -r .isDraft "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json")
  HAS_RELEASE=true
else
  echo "::notice::No GitHub release for $TAG; using dispatch release notes"
  IS_DRAFT=false
  HAS_RELEASE=false
fi

if [[ -z "$NOTES" ]]; then
  NOTES="${PAYLOAD_RELEASE_NOTES:-}"
fi
if [[ -z "$NOTES" ]]; then
  NOTES="${APP_NAME} v${VERSION} is now live."
fi
printf '%s\n' "$NOTES" > "$NOTES_FILE"

PUBLISHED_AT="${PAYLOAD_EVENT_TIMESTAMP:-}"
if [[ -z "$PUBLISHED_AT" && "$HAS_RELEASE" == "true" ]]; then
  PUBLISHED_AT=$(jq -r '.publishedAt // empty' "$RUNNER_TEMP/release.json")
fi
PUBLISHED_AT="${PUBLISHED_AT:-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)}"

{
  echo "is_draft=$IS_DRAFT"
  echo "has_release=$HAS_RELEASE"
  echo "published_at=$PUBLISHED_AT"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Verify isolated CLI
steps.run:
if ! command -v isolated &>/dev/null; then
  npm install -g --force @isolatedtech/cli
fi
isolated --version

steps.name: Check isolated.tech version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
isolated --json apps versions '${{ vars.ISOLATED_APP_SLUG }}' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/isolated-versions.json"
if jq -e --arg version '${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}' '.versions[]? | select(.version == $version)' "$RUNNER_TEMP/isolated-versions.json" >/dev/null; then
  echo "exists=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "isolated.tech already has v${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}; skipping duplicate publish"
else
  echo "exists=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Download macOS zip from release
steps.run:
TAG='${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}'
gh release download "$TAG" --pattern '*.zip' --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP"
ZIP_PATH=$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.zip' | head -1)
if [[ -z "$ZIP_PATH" ]]; then
  echo "::error::No zip attached to release $TAG. release-macos.yml must attach the Developer ID zip to the draft."
  exit 1
fi
echo "ZIP_PATH=$ZIP_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Publish to isolated.tech
steps.run:
isolated publish \
  --zip "$ZIP_PATH" \
  --app-version '${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}' \
  --slug '${{ vars.ISOLATED_APP_SLUG }}' \
  --notes "$(cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md")" \
  --no-bump

steps.name: Promote draft GitHub release
steps.run: gh release edit '${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}' --draft=false

steps.name: Trigger llm-wiki launch checklist scaffold
steps.run:
if [[ -z "${LLM_WIKI_DISPATCH_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::LLM_WIKI_DISPATCH_TOKEN is not configured; skipping launch checklist dispatch"
  exit 0
fi

GH_TOKEN="$LLM_WIKI_DISPATCH_TOKEN" gh api -X POST repos/CodyBontecou/llm-wiki/dispatches \
  -f event_type=generate-launch-checklist \
  -F "client_payload[app]=$APP_SLUG" \
  -F "client_payload[version]=${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}" \
  -F "client_payload[delivery_key]=${{ steps.meta.outputs.delivery_key }}" \
  -F "client_payload[asc_id]=$ASC_APP_ID" \
  -F "client_payload[repo]=${{ github.repository }}"

steps.name: Record release in internal registry
steps.run:
if [[ -z "${INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_URL:-}" || -z "${INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  echo "::error::INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_URL and INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN are required"
  exit 1
fi

PAYLOAD_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/internal-release.json"
jq -n \
  --arg name "$APP_NAME" \
  --arg slug "$APP_SLUG" \
  --arg appStoreId "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --arg bundleId "$BUNDLE_ID" \
  --arg repoUrl "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}" \
  --arg appStoreUrl "$APP_STORE_URL" \
  --arg version '${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}' \
  --arg platform '${{ steps.meta.outputs.platform }}' \
  --rawfile releaseNotes "$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md" \
  --arg publishedAt '${{ steps.release.outputs.published_at }}' \
  --arg deliveryKey '${{ steps.meta.outputs.delivery_key }}' \
  --arg ascVersionId "${ASCV_ID:-}" \
  --arg source "asc-webhook" \
  --arg sourceUrl "https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}" \
  '{
    app: {
      name: $name,
      slug: $slug,
      appStoreId: $appStoreId,
      bundleId: $bundleId,
      repoUrl: $repoUrl,
      appStoreUrl: $appStoreUrl
    },
    version: $version,
    platform: $platform,
    releaseNotes: $releaseNotes,
    publishedAt: $publishedAt,
    deliveryKey: $deliveryKey,
    ascVersionId: $ascVersionId,
    source: $source,
    sourceUrl: $sourceUrl
  }' > "$PAYLOAD_FILE"

RESP=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST "$INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary "@$PAYLOAD_FILE")
echo "$RESP" | jq -e '.data.release.id and (.error == null)' >/dev/null
echo "Recorded $APP_NAME v${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }} (${{ steps.meta.outputs.platform_label }}) in internal registry"

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Announce ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }} (${{ steps.meta.outputs.platform_label }})"
  echo ""
  if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.dry_run }}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "- Mode: dry run (no release promotion, isolated.tech publish, registry write, or wiki dispatch)"
  fi
  if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.dry_run }}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "- GitHub release: unchanged (dry run)"
    echo "- isolated.tech: skipped (dry run)"
  elif [[ "${{ steps.release.outputs.has_release }}" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "- GitHub release: skipped (no draft existed; submitted via asc directly)"
    echo "- isolated.tech: skipped (no zip available without a draft release)"
  else
    if [[ "${{ steps.release.outputs.is_draft }}" != "true" ]]; then
      echo "- GitHub release: already published"
    elif [[ "${{ steps.promote.outcome }}" == "success" ]]; then
      echo "- GitHub release: promoted from draft"
    elif [[ "${{ steps.promote.outcome }}" == "failure" ]]; then
      echo "- GitHub release: promotion failed"
    else
      echo "- GitHub release: promotion skipped after an earlier failure"
    fi
    if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.platform }}" != "MAC_OS" ]]; then
      echo "- isolated.tech: skipped (iOS)"
    elif [[ "${{ steps.isolated_version.outputs.exists }}" == "true" ]]; then
      echo "- isolated.tech: already published"
    elif [[ "${{ steps.isolated.outcome }}" == "success" ]]; then
      echo "- isolated.tech: published"
    elif [[ "${{ steps.isolated.outcome }}" == "failure" ]]; then
      echo "- isolated.tech: publish failed"
    else
      echo "- isolated.tech: publish skipped after an earlier failure"
    fi
  fi
  if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.dry_run }}" == "true" ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "### Release notes preview"
    echo '```text'
    cat "$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md"
    echo '```'
  fi
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

steps.name: Cancel active submission
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
PLATFORM="${{ github.event.inputs.platform }}"
SUBMISSION_JSON=$(asc review submissions-list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --output json)
ACTIVE_IDS=$(printf '%s' "$SUBMISSION_JSON" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
records = json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]
active = [r for r in records if r["attributes"]["state"] in ("WAITING_FOR_REVIEW", "READY_FOR_REVIEW")]
for r in active:
    print(r["id"], r["attributes"]["platform"], r["attributes"]["state"])
')
COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$ACTIVE_IDS" | grep -c . || true)
if [[ "$COUNT" -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "::notice::No active $PLATFORM review submission found; nothing to cancel"
  exit 0
fi
MATCHING=$(printf '%s\n' "$ACTIVE_IDS" | awk -v p="$PLATFORM" '$2 == p {print $1}')
MATCH_COUNT=$(printf '%s\n' "$MATCHING" | grep -c . || true)
if [[ "$MATCH_COUNT" -ne 1 ]]; then
  echo "::error::Expected exactly one active $PLATFORM submission, found $MATCH_COUNT:"
  printf '%s\n' "$ACTIVE_IDS"
  exit 1
fi
SUBMISSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$MATCHING")
echo "Cancelling $PLATFORM review submission $SUBMISSION_ID"
asc review submissions-update --id "$SUBMISSION_ID" --canceled=true --confirm

steps.name: Show resulting app info records
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
asc apps info list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --output table

steps.name: Configure Git defaults

steps.name: Verify build-number format
steps.run:
set -e
bad=$(awk '/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION =/ { gsub(/[ \t;]/, "", $3); print $3 }' \
        HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj | sort -u | grep -vE '^[0-9]{12}$' || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "::error::CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION must be a 12-digit YYYYMMDDHHMM timestamp."
  echo "Offending values:"
  echo "$bad"
  echo
  echo "Why: a small integer (e.g. \"1\", \"2\") would be numerically less than the"
  echo "freemium build threshold and silently auto-unlock the paywall for all new"
  echo "installs (the v1.8.0/1.8.1 bug)."
  exit 1
fi

# Reject any Info.plist whose CFBundleVersion is a literal value
# rather than the $(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION) macro.
# shellcheck disable=SC2016
while IFS= read -r plist; do
  value=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print CFBundleVersion" "$plist" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$value" ] && [ "$value" != '$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION)' ]; then
    echo "::error::$plist hardcodes CFBundleVersion = \"$value\". Use \$(CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION) instead."
    echo "Why: a literal value silently overrides pbxproj bumps and asc xcode version edit."
    exit 1
  fi
  mvalue=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Print CFBundleShortVersionString" "$plist" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$mvalue" ] && [ "$mvalue" != '$(MARKETING_VERSION)' ]; then
    echo "::error::$plist hardcodes CFBundleShortVersionString = \"$mvalue\". Use \$(MARKETING_VERSION) instead."
    exit 1
  fi
done < <(find HealthMd -name 'Info.plist' -not -path '*/build/*')

steps.name: Validate prepared shared Rust core
steps.run:
test -f Packages/HealthMdCoreRust/Artifacts/HealthmdCore.xcframework/Info.plist
test -s Packages/HealthMdCoreRust/Artifacts/.healthmd-core-source.sha256
../../packages/healthmd-core-rust/scripts/validate-apple-xcframework.sh \
  Packages/HealthMdCoreRust/Artifacts/HealthmdCore.xcframework

set -euo pipefail

set -euo pipefail
result=build/test-results/HealthMd-iOS.xcresult

  echo "::error::xcodebuild did not create the iOS xcresult bundle"

fi

import json
import os

summary = json.loads(os.environ["RESULT_SUMMARY"])
result = summary.get("result", "Unknown")
failures = summary.get("failedTests", 0)
details = "; ".join(
    failure.get("failureText", failure.get("testName", "unknown test failure"))
    for failure in summary.get("testFailures", [])[:5]
)
if result != "Passed" or failures:
    print(f"::error::xcresult reports {result} with {failures} failed tests: {details}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
else:
    print(f"xcresult reports Passed: {summary.get('passedTests', 0)} passed, "
          f"{summary.get('skippedTests', 0)} skipped")
PY

steps.name: Configure asc CLI
steps.run:
if [[ -z "$ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET" || -z "$ASC_ISSUER_ID_SECRET" || -z "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Missing ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, or ASC_API_KEY_P8 repository secret"
  exit 1
fi
ASC_KEY_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/.asc-keys"
mkdir -p "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
chmod 700 "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
ASC_KEY_PATH="$ASC_KEY_DIR/AuthKey_${ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET}.p8"
if ! printf '%s' "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" | base64 --decode > "$ASC_KEY_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '%s' "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" > "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
fi
chmod 600 "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
{
  echo "ASC_KEY_ID=$ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_ISSUER_ID=$ASC_ISSUER_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=$ASC_KEY_PATH"
  echo "ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Resolve App Store version
steps.run:
if [[ -z "$ASCV_ID" || -z "$REVIEW_STATE" || -z "$EVENT_TIMESTAMP" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Dispatch is missing appStoreVersionId, state, or eventTimestamp"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$PAYLOAD_APP_STORE_ID" != "$ASC_APP_ID" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Dispatch App Store ID '$PAYLOAD_APP_STORE_ID' does not match '$ASC_APP_ID'"
  exit 1
fi
V_JSON=$(asc versions view --version-id "$ASCV_ID" --output json)
VERSION=$(printf '%s' "$V_JSON" | jq -r '.versionString // .attributes.versionString // .data.attributes.versionString // empty')
PLATFORM=$(printf '%s' "$V_JSON" | jq -r '.platform // .attributes.platform // .data.attributes.platform // empty')
[[ "$PLATFORM" == "MACOS" ]] && PLATFORM=MAC_OS
if [[ -z "$VERSION" || -z "$PLATFORM" ]]; then
  echo "::error::asc versions view returned an unexpected response"
  printf '%s\n' "$V_JSON"
  exit 1
fi
case "$PLATFORM" in IOS|MAC_OS) ;; *) echo "::error::Unsupported platform: $PLATFORM"; exit 1 ;; esac
echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "platform=$PLATFORM" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Record review transition
steps.run:
if [[ -z "$INTERNAL_REVIEW_STATE_API_URL" || -z "$INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN" ]]; then
  echo "::error::INTERNAL_REVIEW_STATE_API_URL and INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN are required"
  exit 1
fi
PAYLOAD_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/review-state.json"
jq -n \
  --arg name "$APP_NAME" --arg slug "$APP_SLUG" \
  --arg appStoreId "$ASC_APP_ID" --arg bundleId "$BUNDLE_ID" \
  --arg repoUrl "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg appStoreUrl "$APP_STORE_URL" \
  --arg ascVersionId "$ASCV_ID" --arg version "$VERSION" --arg platform "$PLATFORM" \
  --arg state "$REVIEW_STATE" --arg oldState "$OLD_REVIEW_STATE" \
  --arg eventTimestamp "$EVENT_TIMESTAMP" --arg source "asc-webhook" \
  --arg sourceUrl "$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" \
  '{app:{name:$name,slug:$slug,appStoreId:$appStoreId,bundleId:$bundleId,repoUrl:$repoUrl,appStoreUrl:$appStoreUrl},ascVersionId:$ascVersionId,version:$version,platform:$platform,state:$state,oldState:$oldState,eventTimestamp:$eventTimestamp,source:$source,sourceUrl:$sourceUrl}' \
  > "$PAYLOAD_FILE"
RESPONSE=$(curl --fail-with-body --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --max-time 30 -sS \
  -X POST "$INTERNAL_REVIEW_STATE_API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_RELEASE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary "@$PAYLOAD_FILE")
echo "$RESPONSE" | jq -e '.data.event.id and (.error == null)' >/dev/null
echo "Tracked $APP_NAME v$VERSION ($PLATFORM): $REVIEW_STATE"

strict_validate.description: Fail before submitting if asc validate reports issues

steps.name: Verify confirmation
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.confirm }}" != "SUBMIT" ]]; then
  echo "::error::confirm must be exactly SUBMIT"; exit 1
fi

steps.name: Install asc
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! command -v asc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  brew install asc
fi
asc --version

steps.name: Setup App Store Connect key
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
ASC_KEY_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/.asc-keys"
mkdir -p "$ASC_KEY_DIR"

ASC_KEY_PATH="$ASC_KEY_DIR/AuthKey_${ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET}.p8"
echo "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" | base64 --decode > "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
chmod 600 "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
{
  echo "ASC_KEY_ID=$ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_ISSUER_ID=$ASC_ISSUER_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=$ASC_KEY_PATH"
  echo "ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Resolve version id
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION_JSON=$(asc versions list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --platform "$PLATFORM" --limit 20 --output json)
VERSION_INFO=$(printf '%s' "$VERSION_JSON" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
target = __import__("os").environ["VERSION"].strip()
data = json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]
matches = [v["id"] for v in data if v["attributes"]["versionString"] == target]
if len(matches) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("expected exactly one {} version, found {}".format(target, len(matches)))
print(matches[0])
')
{
  echo "VERSION_ID=$VERSION_INFO"
  echo "PLATFORM=${{ github.event.inputs.platform }}"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Run validate (informational unless strict)
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
if asc validate \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \
  --platform "$PLATFORM" \
  --output table; then
  echo "VALIDATE_RESULT=pass" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
else
  echo "VALIDATE_RESULT=fail" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
  if [[ "$STRICT" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "::error::asc validate reported issues and strict_validate=true"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::warning::asc validate reported issues; continuing because strict_validate=false"
fi

steps.name: Ensure submission contains the version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
ACTIVE_SUB=$(asc review submissions-list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --output json | python3 -c '
import sys, json
records = json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]
active = [r for r in records if r["attributes"]["state"] in ("WAITING_FOR_REVIEW", "READY_FOR_REVIEW")
          and r["attributes"]["platform"] == __import__("os").environ["PLATFORM"]]
if len(active) > 1:
    raise SystemExit("multiple active {} submissions: {}".format(__import__("os").environ["PLATFORM"], [r["id"] for r in active]))
print(active[0]["id"] if active else "")
')
ADDED=0
if [[ -n "$ACTIVE_SUB" ]]; then
  HAS_ITEM=$(asc review items list --submission "$ACTIVE_SUB" --output json | python3 -c '
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin).get("data") or []
print("yes" if any(True for _ in data) else "no")
' || echo "unknown")
  # Try to attach to the active submission unless it already carries items.
  if [[ "$HAS_ITEM" == "no" ]]; then
    if asc review items add --submission "$ACTIVE_SUB" --item-type appStoreVersions --item-id "$VERSION_ID" 2>asc-items-add.err; then
      echo "Attached $VERSION_ID to existing submission $ACTIVE_SUB"
      ADDED=1
    else
      echo "::notice::could not attach to existing submission $ACTIVE_SUB; will replace it"
      cat asc-items-add.err || true
      asc review submissions-update --id "$ACTIVE_SUB" --canceled=true --confirm
    fi
  elif [[ "$HAS_ITEM" == "yes" ]]; then
    echo "::warning::submission $ACTIVE_SUB already carries items; assuming it targets this release"
    SUBMISSION_ID="$ACTIVE_SUB"
    echo "SUBMISSION_ID=$SUBMISSION_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
  fi
fi
if [[ "$ADDED" != "1" && -z "${SUBMISSION_ID:-}" ]]; then
  SUBMISSION_JSON=$(asc review submissions-create --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --platform "$PLATFORM")
  SUBMISSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$SUBMISSION_JSON" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["id"])')
  echo "Created submission $SUBMISSION_ID"
  asc review items add --submission "$SUBMISSION_ID" --item-type appStoreVersions --item-id "$VERSION_ID"
  echo "SUBMISSION_ID=$SUBMISSION_ID" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
elif [[ -z "${SUBMISSION_ID:-}" ]]; then
  echo "SUBMISSION_ID=$ACTIVE_SUB" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
fi

steps.name: Submit for review
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
echo "Submitting submission $SUBMISSION_ID (validate: $VALIDATE_RESULT)"
asc review submissions-submit --id "$SUBMISSION_ID" --confirm

steps.name: Resulting state
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
asc versions view --version-id "$VERSION_ID" --output json | python3 -c '
import sys, json
v = json.load(sys.stdin)
v = v.get("data", v)
attrs = v.get("attributes", v)
print("version:", attrs.get("versionString"), attrs.get("appStoreState"))
'

python3 - "$RUNNER_OS" "$state" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import threading

runner, state = sys.argv[1:]
executable = pathlib.Path("target/debug/healthmd" + (".exe" if runner == "Windows" else ""))
compatibility = pathlib.Path("target/debug/healthmd-mcp" + (".exe" if runner == "Windows" else ""))
requests = [
    {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-11-25","capabilities":{"extensions":{"io.modelcontextprotocol/ui":{"mimeTypes":["text/html;profile=mcp-app"]}}}}},
    {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}},
    {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"resources/list","params":{}},
    {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":4,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"healthmd_capabilities","arguments":{}}},
    {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":5,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"healthmd_doctor","arguments":{}}},
]
env = os.environ.copy()
env["HEALTHMD_CLI_DATA_DIR"] = state + "-mcp"
def run_stdio_server(command):
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        command,
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True,
        env=env,
    )
    assert process.stdin is not None
    assert process.stdout is not None
    assert process.stderr is not None
    responses = {}
    read_failure = []

    def collect_responses():
        try:
            while len(responses) < len(requests):
                line = process.stdout.readline()
                if not line:
                    raise RuntimeError("MCP server exited before every response")
                value = json.loads(line)
                if "id" in value:
                    responses[value["id"]] = value
        except BaseException as error:
            read_failure.append(error)

    reader = threading.Thread(target=collect_responses, daemon=True)
    reader.start()
    for request in requests:
        process.stdin.write(json.dumps(request) + "\n")
        process.stdin.flush()
    # Keep stdin open until every response arrives. Closing it immediately would
    # correctly cancel in-flight direct readiness calls and make this smoke racy.
    reader.join(timeout=30)
    if reader.is_alive():
        process.kill()
        reader.join(timeout=5)
        raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(command, 30)
    process.stdin.close()
    try:
        return_code = process.wait(timeout=5)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        process.kill()
        return_code = process.wait(timeout=5)
    stderr = process.stderr.read()
    assert not read_failure, read_failure
    assert return_code == 0, (return_code, stderr)
    assert not stderr, stderr
    return responses

responses = run_stdio_server([str(executable), "mcp", "serve"])
assert responses[1]["result"]["capabilities"]["extensions"]["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]["mimeTypes"] == ["text/html;profile=mcp-app"]
tools = responses[2]["result"]["tools"]
tool_names = {tool["name"] for tool in tools}
assert len(tools) == 19
assert "healthmd_metric_chart" in tool_names
assert {"healthmd_pairing_start", "healthmd_pairing_status"} <= tool_names
sleep = next(tool for tool in tools if tool["name"] == "healthmd_sleep_sessions")
assert len(sleep["inputSchema"]["properties"]["dates"]["oneOf"]) == 2
assert sleep["inputSchema"]["examples"][0]["all_pages"] is True
assert responses[3]["result"]["resources"][0]["uri"] == "ui://healthmd/query-visualization-v1"
capability_text = responses[4]["result"]["content"][0]["text"]
capabilities = json.loads(capability_text)
assert "requires_mac_app" not in capabilities
assert capabilities["query_tool_guidance"]["sleep"] == "healthmd_sleep_sessions"
doctor_result = responses[5]["result"]
assert isinstance(doctor_result, dict), doctor_result
assert set(doctor_result) == {"content", "isError"}, doctor_result
assert isinstance(doctor_result["isError"], bool), doctor_result
assert isinstance(doctor_result["content"], list), doctor_result
assert len(doctor_result["content"]) == 1, doctor_result
doctor_content = doctor_result["content"][0]
assert isinstance(doctor_content, dict), doctor_content
assert set(doctor_content) == {"type", "text"}, doctor_content
assert doctor_content["type"] == "text", doctor_content
assert isinstance(doctor_content["text"], str), doctor_content
doctor = json.loads(doctor_content["text"])
assert isinstance(doctor, dict), doctor
if doctor_result["isError"]:
    health_free_errors = {
        "healthmd_not_paired", "healthmd_device_ambiguous", "healthmd_timeout",
        "healthmd_response_too_large", "healthmd_protocol_error",
        "healthmd_pairing_required", "healthmd_unavailable",
    }
    assert set(doctor) == {"error", "message"}, doctor
    assert doctor["error"] in health_free_errors, doctor
    assert isinstance(doctor["message"], str) and doctor["message"], doctor
else:
    health_free_fields = {
        "schema", "schema_version", "status", "ready", "message", "device_name",
        "application_protocol_version", "port", "app_active",
        "protected_data_available", "export_in_progress", "query_in_progress",
        "can_trigger_file_exports", "can_trigger_queries", "active_job_id",
        "active_query_request_id", "query_capabilities", "next_tool", "wake",
    }
    assert set(doctor) <= health_free_fields, doctor
    assert doctor["schema"] == "healthmd.direct_readiness", doctor
    assert doctor["schema_version"] == 1, doctor
    assert doctor["status"] in {"ready", "unavailable", "not_paired", "query_unsupported"}, doctor
    assert isinstance(doctor["ready"], bool), doctor
    assert doctor["ready"] == (doctor["status"] == "ready"), doctor
    assert isinstance(doctor["message"], str) and doctor["message"], doctor
    if doctor["status"] == "not_paired":
        assert isinstance(doctor.get("next_tool"), str), doctor
        assert doctor["next_tool"] == "healthmd_pairing_start", doctor
    if "wake" in doctor:
        # RFC-0005: enrollment is reported truthfully per selected device. This smoke
        # runs against a fresh state with nothing paired and no stored wake credential,
        # so the honest report is wait-only. (Enrolled devices report
        # {"mode": "enrolled", "state": "available"}; pinned in the Rust unit tests.)
        assert doctor["wake"]["enrollment"] == {
            "mode": "wait_only", "state": "unavailable",
        }, doctor
        assert isinstance(doctor["wake"]["timeout_seconds"], int), doctor
        assert isinstance(doctor["wake"]["enabled"], bool), doctor
compatibility_responses = run_stdio_server([str(compatibility)])
# Separate processes can serialize equivalent JSON object keys in a different order.
assert compatibility_responses == responses, (compatibility_responses, responses)
PY

steps.name: Create immutable draft
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
find_release() {
  gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" \
    | jq -e --arg tag "$TAG" \
      '[.[] | select(.tag_name == $tag)] | if length == 1 then .[0] else empty end'
}

if release="$(find_release)"; then
  test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$release")" = true
  test "$(jq -r .target_commitish <<<"$release")" = "$RELEASE_SHA"
  test "$(jq -r .prerelease <<<"$release")" = "$(jq -r .announcement_is_prerelease <<<"$PLAN")"
  echo "Reusing existing draft release for $TAG"
else
  title="$(jq -r '.announcement_title // .releases[0].display_name // empty' <<<"$PLAN")"
  [[ -n "$title" ]] || title="Health.md CLI $VERSION"
  notes="$RUNNER_TEMP/notes.md"
  jq -r '.announcement_github_body // .releases[0].release_notes // "See apps/cli/CHANGELOG.md."' <<<"$PLAN" > "$notes"
  release_flags=(--draft --latest=false)
  if [[ "$(jq -r .announcement_is_prerelease <<<"$PLAN")" == true ]]; then
    release_flags+=(--prerelease)
  fi
  gh release create "$TAG" --verify-tag --target "$RELEASE_SHA" \
    "${release_flags[@]}" --title "$title" --notes-file "$notes"
fi

# GitHub's release-list endpoint can lag a successful create. Recover within this
# job instead of forcing a whole release-workflow rerun after the draft already exists.
release=""
for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
  if release="$(find_release)"; then
    break
  fi
  echo "Draft release is not visible yet (attempt $attempt/12); retrying..."
  sleep 2
done
[[ -n "$release" ]] || {
  echo "::error::Draft release was created but did not become readable in time"
  exit 1
}
release_id="$(jq -r .id <<<"$release")"
[[ "$release_id" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
release="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id")"
test "$(jq -r .tag_name <<<"$release")" = "$TAG"
test "$(jq -r .target_commitish <<<"$release")" = "$RELEASE_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$release")" = true
echo "release-id=$release_id" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Replace unsigned platform archives exactly
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir release
cp -R unsigned/. release/
targets="aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin"
if [[ "$WINDOWS_SIGNING" == qualified ]]; then
  targets="$targets x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
fi
for target in $targets; do
  case "$target" in
    *windows*) extension=zip ;;
    *) extension=tar.xz ;;
  esac
  name="healthmd-cli-${target}.${extension}"
  replacement="$(find signed -type f -name "$name" -print -quit)"
  destination="$(find release -type f -name "$name" -print -quit)"
  checksum="$(find release -type f -name "${name}.sha256" -print -quit)"
  manifest="$(find release -type f -name "${target}-dist-manifest.json" -print -quit)"
  test -n "$replacement" && test -n "$destination" && test -n "$checksum"
  test -n "$manifest"
  cp "$replacement" "$destination"
  digest="$(sha256sum "$destination" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$name" > "$checksum"
  # Global cargo-dist generation trusts the local manifests, so bind them to the
  # post-signing bytes before generating installers or the Homebrew formula.
  jq --arg name "$name" --arg digest "$digest" '
    if (.artifacts[$name].checksums.sha256 | type) != "string" then
      error("dist manifest lacks archive SHA-256")
    else
      .artifacts[$name].checksums.sha256 = $digest
    end
  ' "$manifest" > "${manifest}.tmp"
  mv "${manifest}.tmp" "$manifest"
done
for target in aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin; do
  dmg="$(find signed -type f -name "healthmd-cli-${target}.dmg" -print -quit)"
  test -n "$dmg"
  cp "$dmg" release/
done
test "$(find release -type f \( -name '*.tar.xz' -o -name '*.zip' \) | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 5
test "$(find release -type f -name '*.dmg' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 2
python3 apps/cli/scripts/verify-generated-release-metadata.py \
  --archives release \
  --manifests release

steps.name: Execute exact packaged candidate
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
archive="$(find candidate -type f \
  \( -name "healthmd-cli-${TARGET}.tar.xz" -o -name "healthmd-cli-${TARGET}.zip" \) \
  -print -quit)"
test -n "$archive"
python3 apps/cli/scripts/safe-extract-release.py "$archive" unpacked
suffix=""
[[ "$RUNNER_OS" == Windows ]] && suffix=".exe"
healthmd="$(find unpacked -type f -name "healthmd${suffix}" -print -quit)"
mcp="$(find unpacked -type f -name "healthmd-mcp${suffix}" -print -quit)"
test -n "$healthmd" && test -n "$mcp"
"$healthmd" --version | grep -F "$VERSION"
"$healthmd" --help >/dev/null
"$healthmd" mcp schema healthmd_sleep_sessions > schema.json
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
value = json.load(open("schema.json", encoding="utf-8"))
assert value["schema"] == "healthmd.mcp_tool_schema"
assert value["tool"]["name"] == "healthmd_sleep_sessions"
PY
"$mcp" --help >/dev/null

steps.name: Verify Developer ID, notarization, and stapling after extraction
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(jq -r .apple.team_id apps/cli/release-identities.json)" = "$APPLE_TEAM_ID"
healthmd_identifier="$(jq -r .apple.healthmd_identifier apps/cli/release-identities.json)"
healthmd_mcp_identifier="$(jq -r .apple.healthmd_mcp_identifier apps/cli/release-identities.json)"
for executable in unpacked/*/healthmd unpacked/*/healthmd-mcp; do
  codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 "$executable"
  details="$(codesign -dv --verbose=4 "$executable" 2>&1)"
  grep -F "TeamIdentifier=${APPLE_TEAM_ID}" <<<"$details"
  expected_identifier="$healthmd_identifier"
  [[ "$(basename "$executable")" == healthmd-mcp ]] && expected_identifier="$healthmd_mcp_identifier"
  test "$(sed -n 's/^Identifier=//p' <<<"$details")" = "$expected_identifier"
  # Apple does not support stapling a ticket to, or Gatekeeper assessment of, a bare
  # executable; notarization evidence for these binaries is the accepted, stapled DMG
  # carrying byte-identical copies.
done
dmg="$(find candidate -type f -name "healthmd-cli-${TARGET}.dmg" -print -quit)"
test -n "$dmg"
codesign --verify --strict --verbose=2 "$dmg"
xcrun stapler validate "$dmg"
spctl --assess --type open --context context:primary-signature --verbose=2 "$dmg"

steps.name: Verify installer Authenticode
Recompute and sign exact final checksum manifest
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t archives < <(find release -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.tar.xz' -o -name '*.zip' \) -print | sort)
mapfile -t dmgs < <(find release -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.dmg' -print | sort)
test "${#archives[@]}" = 5
test "${#dmgs[@]}" = 2
mapfile -t archive_checksums < <(find release -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.sha256' -print | sort)
mapfile -t sbom_payloads < <(find sbom -maxdepth 1 -type f -print | sort)
test "${#archive_checksums[@]}" = 5
test "${#sbom_payloads[@]}" = 3
dmg_checksums=()
for dmg in "${dmgs[@]}"; do
  checksum="global/$(basename "$dmg").sha256"
  digest="$(sha256sum "$dmg" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$(basename "$dmg")" > "$checksum"
  dmg_checksums+=("$checksum")
done
cp apps/cli/release-identities.json global/release-identities.json
test "$(jq -r .windows.status global/release-identities.json)" = "$WINDOWS_SIGNING"
if [[ "$WINDOWS_SIGNING" == qualified ]]; then
  test -n "$(jq -r .windows.publisher_subject global/release-identities.json)"
else
  test "$(jq -r .windows.publisher_subject global/release-identities.json)" = null
fi
python3 apps/cli/scripts/verify-generated-release-metadata.py \
  --archives release \
  --manifests release \
  --shell global/healthmd-cli-installer.sh \
  --powershell global/healthmd-cli-installer.ps1 \
  --formula global/healthmd.rb
payloads=(
  "${archives[@]}"
  "${dmgs[@]}"
  "${archive_checksums[@]}"
  "${dmg_checksums[@]}"
  "${sbom_payloads[@]}"
  global/healthmd-cli-installer.sh
  global/healthmd-cli-installer.ps1
  global/healthmd.rb
  global/release-identities.json
)
test "${#payloads[@]}" = 21
printf '%s\n' "${payloads[@]##*/}" | LC_ALL=C sort | uniq -d > duplicate-names.txt
test ! -s duplicate-names.txt
: > global/sha256.sum
for payload in "${payloads[@]}"; do
  test -f "$payload"
  digest="$(sha256sum "$payload" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
  printf '%s  %s\n' "$digest" "$(basename "$payload")" >> global/sha256.sum
done
LC_ALL=C sort -k2,2 -o global/sha256.sum global/sha256.sum
cosign sign-blob --yes \
  --bundle global/sha256.sum.sigstore.json \
  global/sha256.sum

with.subject-path:
global/healthmd-cli-installer.sh
global/healthmd-cli-installer.ps1
global/healthmd.rb
global/release-identities.json
global/sha256.sum
global/sha256.sum.sigstore.json
global/*.dmg.sha256

steps.name: Verify global release closure
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cd candidate
sha256sum --check sha256.sum
for checksum in *.sha256; do sha256sum --check "$checksum"; done
if [[ "$PUBLISHING" == true ]]; then
  expected_identity="${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/.github/workflows/cli-release.yml@${GITHUB_REF}"
  cosign verify-blob \
    --bundle sha256.sum.sigstore.json \
    --certificate-identity "$expected_identity" \
    --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
    sha256.sum
  grep -F "$TAG" healthmd-cli-installer.sh healthmd-cli-installer.ps1 healthmd.rb
  if grep -R -F '/releases/latest' healthmd-cli-installer.sh healthmd-cli-installer.ps1 healthmd.rb; then
    echo "installer must not use the repository-wide latest release" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  test "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.dmg' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 2
  test -f healthmd-cli-aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg.sha256
  test -f healthmd-cli-x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg.sha256
fi
test "$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.tar.xz' -o -name '*.zip' \) | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 5
python3 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps/cli/scripts/verify-generated-release-metadata.py" \
  --archives . \
  --manifests . \
  --shell healthmd-cli-installer.sh \
  --powershell healthmd-cli-installer.ps1 \
  --formula healthmd.rb

steps.name: Compare every remote asset byte-for-byte
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
find expected -type f \( -name '*-dist-manifest.json' -o -name 'plan-dist-manifest.json' \) -delete
[[ "$RELEASE_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]

test "$(jq -r .tag_name <<<"$release")" = "$TAG"

  --bundle remote/sha256.sum.sigstore.json \

steps.name: Atomically publish without changing repository latest
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch --force origin "refs/tags/$TAG:refs/tags/$TAG"
test "$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/$TAG^{commit}")" = "$RELEASE_SHA"
[[ "$RELEASE_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
release="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$RELEASE_ID")"
test "$(jq -r .id <<<"$release")" = "$RELEASE_ID"
test "$(jq -r .tag_name <<<"$release")" = "$TAG"
test "$(jq -r .target_commitish <<<"$release")" = "$RELEASE_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$release")" = true
expected_prerelease="$(jq -r .announcement_is_prerelease <<<"$PLAN")"
test "$(jq -r .prerelease <<<"$release")" = "$expected_prerelease"
gh api --method PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$RELEASE_ID" \
  -F draft=false -f make_latest=false >/dev/null
release="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/tags/$TAG")"
test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$release")" = false
while IFS= read -r expected_asset; do
  jq -e --arg name "$expected_asset" \
    '.assets | any(.name == $name)' <<<"$release" >/dev/null
done < <(jq -r '.releases[0].artifacts[]' <<<"$PLAN")
for expected_asset in \
  "healthmd-cli-$VERSION.spdx.json" \
  "healthmd-cli-$VERSION.cdx.json" \
  "healthmd-cli-$VERSION.sbom.sha256" \
  "healthmd-cli-aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg" \
  "healthmd-cli-aarch64-apple-darwin.dmg.sha256" \
  "healthmd-cli-x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg" \
  "healthmd-cli-x86_64-apple-darwin.dmg.sha256" \
  "release-identities.json" \
  "sha256.sum.sigstore.json"; do
  jq -e --arg name "$expected_asset" \
    '.assets | any(.name == $name)' <<<"$release" >/dev/null
done
latest="$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/latest" --jq .tag_name)"
test "$latest" != "$TAG"

steps.name: Commit generated formula idempotently
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git config user.name "$GITHUB_USER"
git config user.email "$GITHUB_EMAIL"
while IFS= read -r release; do
  filename="$(jq -r '.artifacts[] | select(endswith(".rb"))' <<<"$release")"
  name="${filename%.rb}"
  version="$(jq -r .app_version <<<"$release")"
  source_formula="$(find "$RUNNER_TEMP/formula-artifact" -type f -name "$filename" -print -quit)"
  test -n "$source_formula"
  mkdir -p Formula
  cp "$source_formula" "Formula/$filename"
  export PATH="/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin:$PATH"
  brew update
  # Homebrew's style wrapper cannot exclude plugin-provided Sorbet sigil cops. Analyze
  # an otherwise byte-identical copy with only the required analysis sigil prepended;
  # installation and publication continue to use the exact sealed formula.
  style_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/style-$name"
  mkdir "$style_dir"
  {
    printf '# typed: strict\n\n'
    cat "Formula/$filename"
  } > "$style_dir/$filename"
  tail -n +3 "$style_dir/$filename" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-$filename-body"
  cmp "$RUNNER_TEMP/style-$filename-body" "Formula/$filename"
  brew style --except-cops \
    FormulaAudit/Homepage,FormulaAudit/Desc,FormulaAuditStrict,Style/MutableConstant,Layout/HashAlignment,Style/TrailingCommaInHashLiteral,Style/Documentation,Style/FrozenStringLiteralComment \
    "$style_dir/$filename"
  if brew list --formula "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    brew uninstall --force "$name"
  fi
  if brew list --formula "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "formula remains installed before clean-install qualification: $name" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  qualification_tap=codybontecou/tap
  if brew tap | grep -Fxq "$qualification_tap"; then
    echo "$qualification_tap was already tapped before qualification" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  brew tap "$qualification_tap"
  managed_tap="$(brew --repo "$qualification_tap")"
  test "$(git -C "$managed_tap" rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')" = "$(git rev-parse 'HEAD^{commit}')"
  test -z "$(git -C "$managed_tap" status --porcelain)"
  mkdir -p "$managed_tap/Formula"
  cp "$source_formula" "$managed_tap/Formula/$filename"
  cmp "$managed_tap/Formula/$filename" "Formula/$filename"

  brew install "$qualification_tap/$name"
  prefix="$(brew --prefix "$name")"
  "$prefix/bin/healthmd" --version | grep -F "$version"
  "$prefix/bin/healthmd" --help >/dev/null
  "$prefix/bin/healthmd-mcp" --help >/dev/null
  brew uninstall --force "$name"
  test ! -e "$prefix/bin/healthmd"
  test ! -e "$prefix/bin/healthmd-mcp"
  cmp "$managed_tap/Formula/$filename" "$source_formula"
  git -C "$managed_tap" reset --hard HEAD
  test -z "$(git -C "$managed_tap" status --porcelain)"
  brew untap "$qualification_tap"
  if brew tap | grep -Fxq "$qualification_tap"; then
    echo "$qualification_tap remains tapped after qualification" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  git add "Formula/$filename"
  if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
    git commit -m "$name $version"
  fi
done < <(jq -c '.releases[] | select([.artifacts[] | endswith(".rb")] | any)' <<<"$PLAN")
if [[ "$(git rev-list --count '@{upstream}..HEAD')" -gt 0 ]]; then
  git push
fi
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
