steps.name: Checkout monorepo at the exact event SHA
Compile and run the fail-closed policy without and with inclusion
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
harness="$RUNNER_TEMP/main.swift"
cat > "$harness" <<'SWIFT'
import Foundation

let expectedCompiledIn = CommandLine.arguments.dropFirst().first == "included"
let current = PracticeFeaturePolicy.current
precondition(current.compiledIn == expectedCompiledIn)
precondition(current.qualificationAttested == false)
precondition(current.isEnabled == false)

let exact = PracticeFeaturePolicy.resolve(
    compiledInValue: "included",
    qualificationValue: PracticeFeaturePolicy.qualificationVersion
)
precondition(exact.compiledIn)
precondition(exact.qualificationAttested)
precondition(exact.isEnabled)

for values in [
    (nil, nil),
    ("included", nil),
    (nil, PracticeFeaturePolicy.qualificationVersion),
    ("true", PracticeFeaturePolicy.qualificationVersion),
    ("INCLUDED", PracticeFeaturePolicy.qualificationVersion),
    ("included", "approved"),
] as [(String?, String?)] {
    precondition(PracticeFeaturePolicy.resolve(
        compiledInValue: values.0,
        qualificationValue: values.1
    ).isEnabled == false)
}
SWIFT
# Parse the checked-in Release configurations directly so this focused
# policy gate does not resolve the app's unrelated Swift packages. The
# full Apple workflow owns package/build qualification on its Swift 6.3
# self-hosted toolchain.
project_json="$RUNNER_TEMP/HealthMd-project.json"
plutil -convert json -o "$project_json" apps/apple/HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj
python3 - "$project_json" <<'PY'
import json
import os
import sys

marker = "HEALTHMD_PRACTICE_COMPILED_IN"
with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    project = json.load(handle)
objects = project["objects"]
root = objects[project["rootObject"]]
targets = [
    value for value in objects.values()
    if value.get("isa") == "PBXNativeTarget" and value.get("name") == "HealthMd"
]
if len(targets) != 1:
    raise SystemExit("Expected exactly one HealthMd native target")
if marker in json.dumps(project, sort_keys=True):
    raise SystemExit(f"Checked-in Xcode project must not define {marker}")

checked_configuration_names = {"Release", "Release-iOS"}

def release_settings(owner, label):
    configuration_list = objects[owner["buildConfigurationList"]]
    releases = [
        (objects[identifier].get("name"), objects[identifier])
        for identifier in configuration_list["buildConfigurations"]
        if objects[identifier].get("name") in checked_configuration_names
    ]
    if len(releases) != 2 or {name for name, _ in releases} != checked_configuration_names:
        raise SystemExit(f"Expected exactly one Release and one Release-iOS for {label}")
    for name, release in releases:
        if release.get("baseConfigurationReference"):
            raise SystemExit(f"{label} {name} uses an unchecked base configuration")
    return releases

for label, owner in (("project", root), ("HealthMd target", targets[0])):
    for name, release in release_settings(owner, label):
        serialized = json.dumps(release.get("buildSettings", {}), sort_keys=True)
        if marker in serialized:
            raise SystemExit(f"{label} {name} must fail closed without {marker}")
if os.environ.get("XCODE_XCCONFIG_FILE"):
    raise SystemExit("Hosted environment must not inject XCODE_XCCONFIG_FILE")
for variable, value in os.environ.items():
    if marker in value:
        raise SystemExit(f"Hosted environment variable {variable} unexpectedly defines {marker}")
PY

steps.name: Determine release metadata
steps.run:
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
  if [[ "$TAG" != v* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Release tag must start with 'v' (for example v1.2.3); got '$TAG'"
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="release"
elif [[ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag || '' }}" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag }}"
  if [[ "$TAG" != v* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Manual release tag must start with 'v' (for example v1.2.3); got '$TAG'"
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="manual-release"
elif [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
  TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="tag"
else
  MODE="branch"
  TAG=""
  VERSION=""
  TRIGGER="manual"
fi
{
  echo "mode=$MODE"
  echo "tag=$TAG"
  echo "version=$VERSION"
  echo "trigger=$TRIGGER"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Running in $MODE mode via $TRIGGER (tag=$TAG)"

steps.name: Resolve version from project
steps.run:
# pbxproj is the source of truth; the iOS scheme shares MARKETING_VERSION/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION
# with the macOS scheme so iOS+macOS ship in lockstep on the same tag.
SETTINGS=$(xcodebuild -project HealthMd.xcodeproj -scheme "$XCODE_SCHEME" -configuration Release -showBuildSettings -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' 2>/dev/null)
ACTUAL=$(printf '%s\n' "$SETTINGS" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*MARKETING_VERSION = / {print $NF; exit}')
BUILD=$(printf '%s\n' "$SETTINGS" | awk '/^[[:space:]]*CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = / {print $NF; exit}')

if [[ -z "$ACTUAL" || -z "$BUILD" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Failed to resolve MARKETING_VERSION or CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION from xcodebuild settings"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.mode }}" == "tag" ]]; then
  EXPECTED="${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
  if [[ "$EXPECTED" != "$ACTUAL" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Tag v$EXPECTED does not match resolved MARKETING_VERSION $ACTUAL. Bump pbxproj MARKETING_VERSION, commit, then re-tag."
    exit 1
  fi
else
  if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Branch dispatch requires dry_run=true (only GitHub Release publishes upload to ASC)"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

echo "marketing_version=$ACTUAL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "build_number=$BUILD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Version $ACTUAL, build $BUILD"

security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

CERT_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate.p12"

security import "$CERT_PATH" \
  -P "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" \
  -A -t cert -f pkcs12 \
  -k "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

EXISTING_KEYCHAINS=()
while IFS= read -r keychain; do
  [[ -n "$keychain" ]] && EXISTING_KEYCHAINS+=("$keychain")
done < <(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" "${EXISTING_KEYCHAINS[@]}"
security default-keychain -s "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"
security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign:,productsign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

rm "$CERT_PATH"
echo "KEYCHAIN_PATH=$KEYCHAIN_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

    echo "Release body is empty or unavailable; generating notes from ${PREV_TAG:-first release}"

steps.name: Upload .ipa to App Store Connect
steps.run:
VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
BUILD_NUMBER="${{ steps.version.outputs.build_number }}"

find_build() {
  asc builds list \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --platform IOS \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --limit 1 \
    --output json
}

BUILD_JSON=$(find_build || true)
BUILD_ID=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print("")
    raise SystemExit
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("id", "") if items else "")
')
PROCESSING_STATE=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print("")
    raise SystemExit
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("attributes", {}).get("processingState", "") if items else "")
')

if [[ -n "$BUILD_ID" ]]; then
  echo "Found existing ASC build $BUILD_ID ($PROCESSING_STATE) for $VERSION/$BUILD_NUMBER; skipping upload."
else
  asc builds upload \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --ipa "${{ steps.ipa.outputs.ipa_path }}" \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --wait \
    --poll-interval 30s
fi

if [[ "$PROCESSING_STATE" != "VALID" ]]; then
  asc builds wait \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --platform IOS \
    --timeout 45m \
    --poll-interval 30s \
    --fail-on-invalid
fi

# Discover the processed build through the builds API. The upload operation
# identifier is not an App Store Connect build identifier.
BUILD_JSON=$(find_build)
BUILD_ID=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("id", "") if items else "")
')
PROCESSING_STATE=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("attributes", {}).get("processingState", "") if items else "")
')

if [[ -z "$BUILD_ID" || "$PROCESSING_STATE" != "VALID" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not discover a valid ASC build for $VERSION/$BUILD_NUMBER"
  exit 1
fi

echo "build_id=$BUILD_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
asc builds update --build-id "$BUILD_ID" --uses-non-exempt-encryption=false

steps.name: Create ASC version and submit for review
steps.run:
VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
VERSION_INFO=$(asc versions list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --platform IOS --limit 10 --output json \
  | python3 -c '
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
target = "${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
target_id = ""
prev = ""
for v in items:
    attrs = v.get("attributes", {})
    vs = attrs.get("versionString")
    if vs == target:
        target_id = v.get("id", "")
    elif vs and not prev:
        prev = vs
print(target_id)
print(prev)
')
VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s\n' "$VERSION_INFO" | sed -n '1p')
PREV_VERSION=$(printf '%s\n' "$VERSION_INFO" | sed -n '2p')

if [[ -z "$VERSION_ID" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "$PREV_VERSION" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Could not determine previous iOS version to copy metadata from"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Copying metadata from previous version $PREV_VERSION"
  VERSION_JSON=$(asc versions create \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --platform IOS \
    --copy-metadata-from "$PREV_VERSION" \
    --copy-fields "description,keywords,marketingUrl,promotionalText,supportUrl")
  VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$VERSION_JSON" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
  echo "Created version $VERSION_ID"
else
  echo "Reusing existing iOS version $VERSION_ID"
fi

asc versions attach-build \
  --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \
  --build-id "${{ steps.asc_upload.outputs.build_id }}"

echo "Applying canonical app-info and $VERSION metadata"
if [[ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.app_info }}" ]]; then
  RESOLVED_APP_INFO="${{ github.event.inputs.app_info }}"
else
  # A concurrent platform submission can leave two app info records
  # (the live READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION one plus an editable copy for
  # in-flight versions). Pin the single editable record so asc does
  # not fail closed on the ambiguity.
  RESOLVED_APP_INFO=$(asc apps info list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --output json | python3 -c '
import sys, json
records = json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]
editable = [r for r in records if r["attributes"]["state"] != "READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION"]
if len(records) <= 1:
    print("")
elif len(editable) == 1:
    print(editable[0]["id"])
else:
    raise SystemExit("ambiguous app infos: " + ", ".join("{}[{}]".format(r["id"], r["attributes"]["state"]) for r in records))
')
fi
APP_INFO_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "$RESOLVED_APP_INFO" ]]; then
  APP_INFO_ARGS=(--app-info "$RESOLVED_APP_INFO")
  echo "Using app-info: $RESOLVED_APP_INFO"
fi
asc metadata apply \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --version "$VERSION" \
  --platform IOS \
  --dir metadata \
  --include localizations \
  "${APP_INFO_ARGS[@]}" \
  --output table

IAP_VERSION_IDS=()
while IFS= read -r PRODUCT; do
  IAP_ID=$(printf '%s' "$PRODUCT" | jq -r '.id')
  PRODUCT_ID=$(printf '%s' "$PRODUCT" | jq -r '.productId')

  REMOTE_IAP=$(asc iap view --id "$IAP_ID" --output json)
  REMOTE_PRODUCT_ID=$(printf '%s' "$REMOTE_IAP" \
    | jq -r '.data.attributes.productId // .attributes.productId // empty')
  if [[ "$REMOTE_PRODUCT_ID" != "$PRODUCT_ID" ]]; then
    echo "::error::IAP $IAP_ID resolved to '$REMOTE_PRODUCT_ID', expected '$PRODUCT_ID'"
    exit 1
  fi

  IAP_VERSIONS=$(asc iap versions list \
    --iap-id "$IAP_ID" \
    --paginate \
    --output json)
  IAP_VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$IAP_VERSIONS" \
    | jq -r '[(.data // [])[] | select(.attributes.state == "PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION")][0].id // empty')

  if [[ -z "$IAP_VERSION_ID" ]]; then
    # A concurrent platform submission can move the shared IAP past
    # PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION. Verify the canonical localizations
    # against the waiting/approved version instead of failing.
    echo "::notice::IAP $PRODUCT_ID has no PREPARE_FOR_SUBMISSION version; verifying existing localized metadata"
    REFERENCE_VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$IAP_VERSIONS" \
      | jq -r '[(.data // [])[] | select(.attributes.state == "WAITING_FOR_REVIEW" or .attributes.state == "APPROVED")][0].id // empty')
    if [[ -z "$REFERENCE_VERSION_ID" ]]; then
      echo "::error::IAP $PRODUCT_ID has no editable or approved version to compare against"
      exit 1
    fi
    REMOTE_IAP_LOCALIZATIONS=$(asc iap versions localizations list \
      --version-id "$REFERENCE_VERSION_ID" \
      --paginate \
      --output json)
    IAP_MISMATCH=0
    while IFS= read -r EXPECTED; do
      EXPECTED_LOCALE=$(printf '%s' "$EXPECTED" | jq -r '.locale')
      EXPECTED_NAME=$(printf '%s' "$EXPECTED" | jq -r '.name')
      EXPECTED_DESCRIPTION=$(printf '%s' "$EXPECTED" | jq -r '.description')
      MATCH=$(printf '%s' "$REMOTE_IAP_LOCALIZATIONS" \
        | jq -r --arg locale "$EXPECTED_LOCALE" --arg name "$EXPECTED_NAME" --arg description "$EXPECTED_DESCRIPTION" \
          '[(.data // [])[] | select(.attributes.locale == $locale)][0] as $loc | if $loc == null then "missing" elif $loc.attributes.name != $name or $loc.attributes.description != $description then "differs" else "match" end')
      if [[ "$MATCH" != "match" ]]; then
        echo "::error::IAP $PRODUCT_ID locale $EXPECTED_LOCALE metadata $MATCH on version $REFERENCE_VERSION_ID"
        IAP_MISMATCH=1
      fi
    done < <(printf '%s' "$PRODUCT" \
      | jq -c '.localizations | to_entries[] | {
          locale: .key,
          name: .value.name,
          description: .value.description
        }')
    if [[ "$IAP_MISMATCH" -ne 0 ]]; then
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "IAP $PRODUCT_ID existing metadata matches the canonical localizations"
    continue
  fi

  IAP_LOCALIZATIONS=$(asc iap versions localizations list \
    --version-id "$IAP_VERSION_ID" \
    --paginate \
    --output json)
  while IFS= read -r LOCALIZATION; do
    LOCALE=$(printf '%s' "$LOCALIZATION" | jq -r '.locale')
    NAME=$(printf '%s' "$LOCALIZATION" | jq -r '.name')
    DESCRIPTION=$(printf '%s' "$LOCALIZATION" | jq -r '.description')
    LOCALIZATION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$IAP_LOCALIZATIONS" \
      | jq -r --arg locale "$LOCALE" \
        '[(.data // [])[] | select(.attributes.locale == $locale)][0].id // empty')

    if [[ -n "$LOCALIZATION_ID" ]]; then
      asc iap versions localizations update \
        --localization-id "$LOCALIZATION_ID" \
        --name "$NAME" \
        --description "$DESCRIPTION"
    else
      asc iap versions localizations create \
        --version-id "$IAP_VERSION_ID" \
        --locale "$LOCALE" \
        --name "$NAME" \
        --description "$DESCRIPTION"
    fi
  done < <(printf '%s' "$PRODUCT" \
    | jq -c '.localizations | to_entries[] | {
        locale: .key,
        name: .value.name,
        description: .value.description
      }')

  IAP_VERSION_IDS+=("$IAP_VERSION_ID")
done < <(jq -c '.products[]' metadata/in-app-purchases.json)

asc validate \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \
  --platform IOS \
  --output table

SUBMISSION_JSON=$(asc review submissions-create \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --platform IOS)
SUBMISSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$SUBMISSION_JSON" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["id"])')
echo "Created review submission $SUBMISSION_ID"

asc review items-add \
  --submission "$SUBMISSION_ID" \
  --item-type appStoreVersions \
  --item-id "$VERSION_ID"

for IAP_VERSION_ID in "${IAP_VERSION_IDS[@]}"; do
  asc review items-add \
    --submission "$SUBMISSION_ID" \
    --item-type inAppPurchaseVersions \
    --item-id "$IAP_VERSION_ID"
done

asc review submissions-submit \
  --id "$SUBMISSION_ID" \
  --confirm

steps.name: Ensure GitHub release record exists
steps.run:
TAG="${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
NOTES_FILE="${{ steps.notes.outputs.notes_file }}"

# On release-triggered runs this release already exists and remains published.
# iOS doesn't attach an asset (the .ipa lives in ASC). The fallback keeps
# older tag/manual paths safe if they are reintroduced later.
if gh release view "$TAG" &>/dev/null; then
  echo "Release $TAG already exists; leaving alone (notes already set, possibly with macOS zip attached)"
else
  echo "Creating draft release $TAG (fallback iOS-only path)"
  gh release create "$TAG" \
    --draft \
    --title "$TAG" \
    --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE"
fi

steps.name: Cleanup keychain
steps.run:
if [[ -n "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" ]]; then
  security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Submit iOS ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
  echo ""
  echo "- **Version:** ${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }} (build ${{ steps.version.outputs.build_number }})"
  echo "- **Trigger:** ${{ steps.meta.outputs.trigger }}"
  echo "- **Dry run:** ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run || 'false' }}"
  echo "- **Skip ASC submit:** ${{ github.event.inputs.skip_asc_submit || 'false' }}"
  echo ""
  echo "### Next steps"
  echo "Once ASC review approves the iOS submission, the ASC webhook will fire apple-announce.yml,"
  echo "which publishes the draft release and posts to Discord; iOS skips isolated.tech."
  echo ""
  echo "### Links"
  echo "- [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps/$ASC_APP_ID/appstore)"
  echo "- [GitHub Release](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }})"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

assigned_complete_workflow_maps.parse_method: PyYAML6.0.3 BaseLoader retains on/key/scalar text; raw Git bytes primary

release_tag.description: Existing v* release tag to build from main (for reruns after workflow-only fixes)

dry_run.description: Dry run (build but do not publish anywhere)

skip_asc_upload.description: Build and attach the macOS zip, but skip ASC pkg upload and review submission

steps.name: Configure Git defaults
steps.run: git config --global init.defaultBranch main

steps.name: Determine release metadata
steps.run:
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
  if [[ "$TAG" != v* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Release tag must start with 'v' (for example v1.2.3); got '$TAG'"
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="release"
elif [[ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag || '' }}" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ github.event.inputs.release_tag }}"
  if [[ "$TAG" != v* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Manual release tag must start with 'v' (for example v1.2.3); got '$TAG'"
    exit 1
  fi
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="manual-release"
elif [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
  TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
  VERSION="${TAG#v}"
  MODE="tag"
  TRIGGER="tag"
else
  # Branch dispatch (testing only — must be dry run or skip_asc_submit)
  MODE="branch"
  TAG=""
  VERSION=""
  TRIGGER="manual"
fi
{
  echo "mode=$MODE"
  echo "tag=$TAG"
  echo "version=$VERSION"
  echo "trigger=$TRIGGER"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Running in $MODE mode via $TRIGGER (tag=$TAG)"

steps.name: Prepare and validate shared Rust core for Apple
steps.run: make prepare-healthmd-core-rust

steps.name: Install asc CLI
steps.run:
if ! command -v asc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  brew install asc
fi
asc --version

steps.name: Remove iOS-only Swift packages from macOS release workspace
steps.run:
# The macOS target does not link Notelet, but Xcode resolves every
# project-level Swift package before even showing build settings.
# Remove this iOS-only package reference from the checked-out workspace
# so macOS releases do not depend on unnecessary package networking.
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path("HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj")
ids = {
    "62D100002F60B00000A10000",  # notelet package
    "62D100012F60B00000A10000",  # Notelet product
    "62D100022F60B00000A10000",  # Notelet build file
}
output = []
skip_depth = 0
for line in path.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True):
    if skip_depth > 0:
        skip_depth += line.count("{") - line.count("}")
        continue
    stripped = line.lstrip()
    object_id = stripped.split(" ", 1)[0] if stripped else ""
    if object_id in ids and " = {" in line:
        skip_depth = line.count("{") - line.count("}")
        continue
    if object_id in ids and stripped.endswith(",\n"):
        continue
    output.append(line)
path.write_text("".join(output))
PY

steps.name: Resolve version from project
steps.run:
# pbxproj is the source of truth (commit 6f719cd7). Parse it directly
# so version resolution cannot be blocked by Swift package networking.
ACTUAL=$(awk -F'= ' '/MARKETING_VERSION = / { gsub(/;/, "", $2); print $2; exit }' HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj)
BUILD=$(awk -F'= ' '/CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION = / { gsub(/;/, "", $2); print $2; exit }' HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj)

if [[ -z "$ACTUAL" || -z "$BUILD" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Failed to resolve MARKETING_VERSION or CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION from HealthMd.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj"
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.mode }}" == "tag" ]]; then
  EXPECTED="${{ steps.meta.outputs.version }}"
  if [[ "$EXPECTED" != "$ACTUAL" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Tag v$EXPECTED does not match resolved MARKETING_VERSION $ACTUAL. Bump pbxproj MARKETING_VERSION, commit, then re-tag."
    exit 1
  fi
else
  if [[ "${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Branch dispatch requires dry_run=true (only GitHub Release publishes upload to ASC)"
    exit 1
  fi
fi

echo "marketing_version=$ACTUAL" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "build_number=$BUILD" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Version $ACTUAL, build $BUILD"

steps.name: Import signing certificates
steps.run:
KEYCHAIN_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/signing.keychain-db"
KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -base64 32)

security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"
security set-keychain-settings -lut 21600 "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"
security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

CERT_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/certificate.p12"
echo "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_P12" | base64 --decode > "$CERT_PATH"

security import "$CERT_PATH" \
  -P "$APPLE_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" \
  -A -t cert -f pkcs12 \
  -k "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

EXISTING_KEYCHAINS=()
while IFS= read -r keychain; do
  [[ -n "$keychain" ]] && EXISTING_KEYCHAINS+=("$keychain")
done < <(security list-keychains -d user | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
security list-keychains -d user -s "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" "${EXISTING_KEYCHAINS[@]}"
security default-keychain -s "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"
security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign:,productsign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" "$KEYCHAIN_PATH"

rm "$CERT_PATH"
echo "KEYCHAIN_PATH=$KEYCHAIN_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Install Mac App Store provisioning profile
steps.run:
PROFILE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/HealthMD-MacAppStore.provisionprofile"
echo "$MAC_APP_STORE_PROVISIONING_PROFILE" | base64 --decode > "$PROFILE_PATH"

PROFILE_PLIST="$RUNNER_TEMP/profile-content.plist"
security cms -D -i "$PROFILE_PATH" > "$PROFILE_PLIST"
UUID=$(/usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c 'Print :UUID' "$PROFILE_PLIST")

PROFILE_DIR="$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles"
mkdir -p "$PROFILE_DIR"
cp "$PROFILE_PATH" "$PROFILE_DIR/$UUID.provisionprofile"

echo "PROVISION_PROFILE_PATH=$PROFILE_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "Installed Mac App Store profile $UUID"

steps.name: Resolve Swift packages
steps.run:
xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies \
  -scheme "$XCODE_SCHEME" \
  -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/SourcePackages"

steps.name: Archive (signed with Developer ID)
steps.run:
ARCHIVE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/$APP_NAME.xcarchive"
xcodebuild archive \
  -scheme "$XCODE_SCHEME" \
  -configuration Release \
  -archivePath "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  -clonedSourcePackagesDirPath "$RUNNER_TEMP/SourcePackages" \
  CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual \
  CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Developer ID Application" \
  DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}" \
  OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS="--timestamp --options=runtime"
echo "ARCHIVE_PATH=$ARCHIVE_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Export Developer ID build
steps.run:
cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ExportOptions-DeveloperID.plist" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>method</key>
  <string>developer-id</string>
  <key>teamID</key>
  <string>${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}</string>
  <key>signingStyle</key>
  <string>manual</string>
  <key>signingCertificate</key>
  <string>Developer ID Application</string>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

EXPORT_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/Export-DeveloperID"
xcodebuild -exportArchive \
  -archivePath "$ARCHIVE_PATH" \
  -exportOptionsPlist "$RUNNER_TEMP/ExportOptions-DeveloperID.plist" \
  -exportPath "$EXPORT_PATH"
echo "DEVID_EXPORT_PATH=$EXPORT_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Notarize and staple
steps.run:
APP_PATH="$DEVID_EXPORT_PATH/$APP_NAME.app"
ZIP_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/notarize.zip"
ditto -c -k --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_PATH"
xcrun notarytool submit "$ZIP_PATH" \
  --apple-id "$APPLE_ID" \
  --password "$APPLE_ID_PASSWORD" \
  --team-id "$APPLE_TEAM_ID" \
  --wait
xcrun stapler staple "$APP_PATH"

steps.name: Create release zip (Developer ID)
steps.run:
APP_PATH="$DEVID_EXPORT_PATH/$APP_NAME.app"
ZIP_NAME="$APP_NAME-v${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}.zip"
ZIP_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/$ZIP_NAME"
ditto -c -k --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_PATH"
echo "zip_path=$ZIP_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Build App Store pkg
steps.run:
APPSTORE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/appstore-build"
mkdir -p "$APPSTORE_DIR"
cp -R "$ARCHIVE_PATH/Products/Applications/$APP_NAME.app" "$APPSTORE_DIR/"
APP_PATH="$APPSTORE_DIR/$APP_NAME.app"

cp "$PROVISION_PROFILE_PATH" "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"

cat > "$RUNNER_TEMP/appstore-entitlements.plist" <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>com.apple.application-identifier</key>
  <string>${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}.${{ env.BUNDLE_ID }}</string>
  <key>com.apple.developer.team-identifier</key>
  <string>${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}</string>
  <key>com.apple.security.app-sandbox</key>
  <true/>
  <key>com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-write</key>
  <true/>
  <key>com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-scope</key>
  <true/>
  <key>com.apple.security.network.client</key>
  <true/>
  <key>com.apple.security.network.server</key>
  <true/>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

codesign --force --deep \
  --sign "Apple Distribution: Cody Russell Bontecou (${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }})" \
  --entitlements "$RUNNER_TEMP/appstore-entitlements.plist" \
  --options runtime \
  --timestamp \
  "$APP_PATH"

PKG_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/HealthMd-${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}-appstore.pkg"
productbuild --component "$APP_PATH" /Applications \
  --sign "3rd Party Mac Developer Installer: Cody Russell Bontecou (${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }})" \
  "$PKG_PATH"

echo "pkg_path=$PKG_PATH" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Prepare release notes
steps.run:
NOTES_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"
ASC_NOTES_FILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/asc-notes.txt"

if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "release" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
  NOTES=$(jq -r '.release.body // ""' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")

  if [[ -z "$NOTES" ]]; then
    PREV_TAG=$(git tag --sort=-creatordate | grep '^v' | grep -v "^${TAG}$" | head -1)
    echo "Release body is empty; generating notes from ${PREV_TAG:-first release}"

    if [[ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]]; then
      NOTES=$(gh api -X POST "repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/generate-notes" \
        -f tag_name="$TAG" \
        -f previous_tag_name="$PREV_TAG" \
        --jq .body)
    else
      NOTES=$(gh api -X POST "repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/generate-notes" \
        -f tag_name="$TAG" \
        --jq .body)
    fi
  fi
elif [[ "${{ steps.meta.outputs.mode }}" == "tag" ]]; then
  TAG="${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
  NOTES=$(gh release view "$TAG" --json body --jq '.body // ""' 2>/dev/null || true)

  if [[ -z "$NOTES" ]]; then
    PREV_TAG=$(git tag --sort=-creatordate | grep '^v' | grep -v "^${TAG}$" | head -1)
    echo "Release body is empty or unavailable; generating notes from ${PREV_TAG:-first release}"

    if [[ -n "$PREV_TAG" ]]; then
      NOTES=$(gh api -X POST "repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/generate-notes" \
        -f tag_name="$TAG" \
        -f previous_tag_name="$PREV_TAG" \
        --jq .body)
    else
      NOTES=$(gh api -X POST "repos/${{ github.repository }}/releases/generate-notes" \
        -f tag_name="$TAG" \
        --jq .body)
    fi
  fi
else
  NOTES="[dry-run] Release notes are only generated on release/tag builds."
fi

if [[ -z "$NOTES" ]]; then
  NOTES="Bug fixes and improvements."
fi

printf '%s\n' "$NOTES" > "$NOTES_FILE"
echo "notes_file=$NOTES_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

ASC_NOTES=$(printf '%s\n' "$NOTES" | head -c 3900)
printf '%s' "$ASC_NOTES" > "$ASC_NOTES_FILE"
echo "asc_notes_file=$ASC_NOTES_FILE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "--- Release notes ---"
cat "$NOTES_FILE"

steps.name: Configure asc CLI
steps.run:
ASC_KEY_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/.asc-keys"
mkdir -p "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
chmod 700 "$ASC_KEY_DIR"
ASC_KEY_PATH="$ASC_KEY_DIR/AuthKey_${ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET}.p8"
echo "$ASC_API_KEY_P8" | base64 --decode > "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
chmod 600 "$ASC_KEY_PATH"
{
  echo "ASC_KEY_ID=$ASC_KEY_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_ISSUER_ID=$ASC_ISSUER_ID_SECRET"
  echo "ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH=$ASC_KEY_PATH"
  echo "ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Upload pkg to App Store Connect
steps.run:
VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
BUILD_NUMBER="${{ steps.version.outputs.build_number }}"

find_build() {
  asc builds list \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --platform MAC_OS \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --limit 1 \
    --output json
}

BUILD_JSON=$(find_build || true)
BUILD_ID=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print("")
    raise SystemExit
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("id", "") if items else "")
')
PROCESSING_STATE=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print("")
    raise SystemExit
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("attributes", {}).get("processingState", "") if items else "")
')

if [[ -n "$BUILD_ID" ]]; then
  echo "Found existing ASC build $BUILD_ID ($PROCESSING_STATE) for $VERSION/$BUILD_NUMBER; skipping upload."
else
  asc builds upload \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --pkg "${{ steps.pkg.outputs.pkg_path }}" \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --wait \
    --poll-interval 30s
fi

if [[ "$PROCESSING_STATE" != "VALID" ]]; then
  asc builds wait \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --version "$VERSION" \
    --build-number "$BUILD_NUMBER" \
    --platform MAC_OS \
    --timeout 45m \
    --poll-interval 30s \
    --fail-on-invalid
fi

# Discover the processed build through the builds API. The upload operation
# identifier is not an App Store Connect build identifier.
BUILD_JSON=$(find_build)
BUILD_ID=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("id", "") if items else "")
')
PROCESSING_STATE=$(printf '%s' "$BUILD_JSON" | python3 -c '
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", []) if isinstance(data, dict) else []
print(items[0].get("attributes", {}).get("processingState", "") if items else "")
')

if [[ -z "$BUILD_ID" || "$PROCESSING_STATE" != "VALID" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not discover a valid ASC build for $VERSION/$BUILD_NUMBER"
  exit 1
fi

echo "build_id=$BUILD_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
asc builds update --build-id "$BUILD_ID" --uses-non-exempt-encryption=false

steps.name: Create ASC version and submit for review
steps.run:
VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
VERSION_INFO=$(asc versions list --app "$ASC_APP_ID" --platform MAC_OS --limit 10 --output json \
  | python3 -c '
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
target = "${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}"
target_id = ""
prev = ""
for v in items:
    attrs = v.get("attributes", {})
    vs = attrs.get("versionString")
    if vs == target:
        target_id = v.get("id", "")
    elif vs and not prev:
        prev = vs
print(target_id)
print(prev)
')
VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s\n' "$VERSION_INFO" | sed -n '1p')
PREV_VERSION=$(printf '%s\n' "$VERSION_INFO" | sed -n '2p')

if [[ -z "$VERSION_ID" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "$PREV_VERSION" ]]; then
    echo "::error::Could not determine previous macOS version to copy metadata from"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Copying metadata from previous version $PREV_VERSION"
  VERSION_JSON=$(asc versions create \
    --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
    --version "${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }}" \
    --platform MAC_OS \
    --copy-metadata-from "$PREV_VERSION" \
    --copy-fields "description,keywords,marketingUrl,promotionalText,supportUrl")
  VERSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$VERSION_JSON" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
  echo "Created version $VERSION_ID"
else
  echo "Reusing existing macOS version $VERSION_ID"
fi

asc versions attach-build \
  --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \
  --build "${{ steps.asc_upload.outputs.build_id }}"

DEFAULT_WHATS_NEW=$(cat "${{ steps.notes.outputs.asc_notes_file }}")
LOCALES=$(asc localizations list --version "$VERSION_ID" --output json \
  | python3 -c '
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
items = data.get("data", data) if isinstance(data, dict) else data
for item in items:
    locale = item.get("attributes", {}).get("locale")
    if locale:
        print(locale)
')
if [[ -z "$LOCALES" ]]; then
  LOCALES="en-US"
fi
while IFS= read -r LOCALE; do
  [[ -z "$LOCALE" ]] && continue
  METADATA_FILE="metadata/version/$VERSION/$LOCALE.json"
  WHATS_NEW="$DEFAULT_WHATS_NEW"
  if [[ -f "$METADATA_FILE" ]]; then
    LOCALIZED_WHATS_NEW=$(jq -r '.whatsNew // empty' "$METADATA_FILE")
    [[ -n "$LOCALIZED_WHATS_NEW" ]] && WHATS_NEW="$LOCALIZED_WHATS_NEW"
  fi
  echo "Updating What's New for $LOCALE"
  asc localizations update \
    --locale "$LOCALE" \
    --version "$VERSION_ID" \
    --whats-new "$WHATS_NEW"
done <<< "$LOCALES"

asc validate \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --version-id "$VERSION_ID" \
  --platform MAC_OS \
  --output table

SUBMISSION_JSON=$(asc review submissions-create \
  --app "$ASC_APP_ID" \
  --platform MAC_OS)
SUBMISSION_ID=$(printf '%s' "$SUBMISSION_JSON" | python3 -c 'import sys, json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["data"]["id"])')
echo "Created review submission $SUBMISSION_ID"

asc review items-add \
  --submission "$SUBMISSION_ID" \
  --item-type appStoreVersions \
  --item-id "$VERSION_ID"

asc review submissions-submit \
  --id "$SUBMISSION_ID" \
  --confirm

steps.name: Attach macOS zip to GitHub release
steps.run:
TAG="${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
ZIP_PATH="${{ steps.zip.outputs.zip_path }}"
NOTES_FILE="${{ steps.notes.outputs.notes_file }}"

if gh release view "$TAG" &>/dev/null; then
  # Release-triggered runs already have a published release. If a legacy
  # draft release exists, keep it draft; never demote a published release.
  IS_DRAFT=$(gh release view "$TAG" --json isDraft --jq .isDraft)
  if [[ "$IS_DRAFT" == "true" ]]; then
    echo "Updating existing draft $TAG with notes + macOS zip"
    gh release edit "$TAG" --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE"
  else
    echo "Release $TAG is already published; uploading macOS zip without changing notes"
  fi
  gh release upload "$TAG" "$ZIP_PATH" --clobber
else
  echo "Creating draft release $TAG with macOS zip (fallback path)"
  gh release create "$TAG" \
    --draft \
    --title "$TAG" \
    --notes-file "$NOTES_FILE" \
    "$ZIP_PATH"
fi

steps.name: Cleanup keychain
steps.run:
if [[ -n "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" ]]; then
  security delete-keychain "$KEYCHAIN_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "## Submit macOS ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }}"
  echo ""
  echo "- **Version:** ${{ steps.version.outputs.marketing_version }} (build ${{ steps.version.outputs.build_number }})"
  echo "- **Trigger:** ${{ steps.meta.outputs.trigger }}"
  echo "- **Dry run:** ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run || 'false' }}"
  echo "- **Skip ASC upload:** ${{ github.event.inputs.skip_asc_upload || 'false' }}"
  echo "- **Skip ASC submit:** ${{ github.event.inputs.skip_asc_submit || 'false' }}"
  echo ""
  echo "### Next steps"
  echo "Once ASC review approves the macOS submission, the ASC webhook will fire apple-announce.yml,"
  echo "which publishes the draft release to GitHub and isolated.tech, then posts to Discord."
  echo ""
  echo "### Links"
  echo "- [App Store Connect](https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps/$ASC_APP_ID/appstore)"
  echo "- [GitHub Release](https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/releases/tag/${{ steps.meta.outputs.tag }})"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

durable_lifecycle.admission: Freeze request/product/profile/destination/peer/fingerprint before prepare; validate journal equality on reopen; do not reinterpret job input
durable_lifecycle.partition_commit: authenticated chunk sequence/byte bounds; disk-backed incremental digest; verify complete partition digest/count then rename spool and persist journal/counters before returning partition acknowledgement
durable_lifecycle.reconciliation: exact committed descriptor returns skip only when spool digest matches; lost/corrupt retained spool can cause rollback/re-request of affected suffix (v1) or replacement partition (v2); expose loss rather than fabricate retention
durable_lifecycle.final_commit: validate complete corpus/manifests, materialize bounded artifact/generated destination, persist receipt and AwaitingPeerAcknowledgement before final ack
durable_lifecycle.peer_completion: Completed only after peer confirms final acknowledgement; duplicate confirmed completion accepted; v2 removes input artifact spool only after durable completion
durable_lifecycle.cancel: explicit marker persisted before delivery; CancellationPending until peer acknowledgement; local query/wake interruption is not remote cancellation; cancel removes private incomplete input, not previously committed destination files
durable_lifecycle.expiration: seven-day record lifetime; cleanup skips active execution lease; unknown/corrupt records not silently migrated
durable_lifecycle.retained_state: Current Rust stores read exact versions only; no TypeScript writer or engine-pin migration installed. Every state including awaiting ack/cancel pending and generated before/after plans needs successor/read-old/write-compatible proof. No full frozen installed-journal corpus identified; existing tests construct synthetic states inline.
durable_lifecycle.downgrade: Retain immutable prior signed archives, current Rust authority and exact old job/source/profile pins. Rollback binary may resume only proven wire/state-compatible jobs; unknown outcomes pause. Do not delete/rewrite committed files or trust to force rollback. No old-to-new Node or downgrade matrix executed.
